        mix-blend-mode: overlay;
        z-index: 2;
        pointer-events: none;
        border-radius: inherit;
      }

      @keyframes rulesFloatDistort {
        0%   { background-position: 0% 0%; }
        50%  { background-position: 100% 100%; }
        100% { background-position: 0% 0%; }
      }

        position: relative !important;

      }

      .modal.rules-glass .snipzy-glass-card.rule-card,

      }

      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .modal.rules-glass .snipzy-glass-card > .glass-distortion-overlay {
          animation: none !important;
        }
      }

       transform: scale(.78);\n        transition:\n          opacity .20s ease,\n          filter .24s ease,\n          transform .34s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);\n        pointer-events: none;\n button.dataset.downloadMotion === \"1\") return;\n\n        button.dataset.downloadMotion = \"1\";\n\n        const rect = button.getBoundingClientRect();\n        const previous = {\n          width: button.style.width,\n          minWidth: button.style.minWidth,\n          position: button.style.position\n        };\n\n        // Lock the current size so swapping content never moves the toolbar.\n        if (rect.width > 0) {\n          button.style.width = `${rect.width}px`;\n          button.style.minWidth = `${rect.width}px`;\n        }\n\n        if (getComputedStyle(button).position === \"static\") {\n          button.style.position = \"relative\";\n        }\n\n        const original = document.createElement(\"span\");\n        original.className = \"download-motion-original\";\n\n        while (button.firstChild) {\n          original.appendChild(button.firstChild);\n        }\n\n        const success = document.createElement(\"span\");\n        success.className = \"download-motion-success\";\n        success.setAttribute(\"aria-hidden\", \"true\");\n        success.innerHTML = `\n          <svg button.classList.add(\"download-motion-mounted\");\n\n        requestAnimationFrame(() => {\n          requestAnimationFrame(() => {\n            button.classList.add(\"download-motion-active\");\n          });\n        });\n\n        clearTimeout(button.__downloadMotionTimer);\n        button.__downloadMotionTimer = setTimeout(() => {\n          button.classList.remove(\"download-motion-active\");\n\n          setTimeout(() => {\n            if (!button.isConnected) return;\n\n            while (original.firstChild) {\n              button.insertBefore(original.firstChild, original);\n            }\n\n            original.remove();\n            success.remove();\n\n            button.classList.remove(\"download-motion-mounted\");\n            delete button.dataset.downloadMotion;\n\n            button.style.width = previous.width;\n            button.style.minWidth =       function showDownloadErrorAnimation(selector) {
        const button = document.querySelector(selector);
        if (!button) return;
        clearTimeout(button.__downloadErrorTimer);
        clearTimeout(button.__downloadErrorCleanupTimer);

        // Keep the button's box metrics stable while swapping only the icon layer.
        const rect = button.getBoundingClientRect();
        const previous = {
          width: button.style.width,
          minWidth: button.style.minWidth,
          height: button.style.height,
          minHeight: button.style.minHeight,
          position: button.style.position
        };
        if (rect.width > 0) {
          button.style.width = String(rect.width) + "px";
          button.style.minWidth = String(rect.width) + "px";
        }
        if (rect.height > 0) {
          button.style.height = String(rect.height) + "px";
          button.style.minHeight = String(rect.height) + "px";
        }
        if (getComputedStyle(button).position === "static") {
          button.style.position = "relative";
        }

        let errorLayer = button.querySelector(".download-motion-error");
        if (!errorLayer) {
          errorLayer = document.createElement("span");
          errorLayer.className = "download-motion-error";
          errorLayer.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
          errorLayer.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path pathLength="1" d="M7 7l10 10M17 7 7 17"/></svg>';
          button.appendChild(errorLayer);
        }
        button.classList.add("download-error-state");
        button.__downloadErrorTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          if (!button.isConnected) return;
          button.classList.remove("download-error-state");

            button.style.height = previous.height;
            button.style.minHeight = previous.minHeight;
            button.style.position = previous.position;
          }, 220);

      }

["section"]\n            : exportPdfPages === "plan"\n              ? ["plan"]\n              : ["section", "plan"];\n\n          for (const view of exportViews) {'

        '        const geom = buildRampGeometry(state.result || invalidResult());\n        const exportDxfView = document.querySelector("#exportDxfView")?.value || state.view;\n        const exportDxfUnit = document.querySelector("#exportDxfUnit")?.value || selectedLengthUnit();\n        const exportDxfWidthUnit = document.querySelector("#exportDxfWidthUnit")?.value || exportDxfUnit;\n        const widthInputValue = Number(document.querySelector("#exportDxfWidth")?.value);\n        const widthM = Number.isFinite(widthInputValue) && widthInputValue > 0\n          ? (exportDxfWidthUnit === "cm" ? widthInputValue / 100 : widthInputValue)\n          : (Number(geom.widthM) || 1.2);\n        const exportDxfWidth = Math.max(0.01, widthM * (exportDxfUnit === "cm" ? 100 : 1));\n        const dxfScale = exportDxfUnit === "cm" ? 100 : 1;\n        const insUnits = exportDxfUnit === "cm" ? 5 : 6;\n        const dxfValue = value => Number((Number(value) * dxfScale).toFixed(exportDxfUnit === "cm" ? 3 : 6));'

      @keyframes exportPanelIn { from { opacity: .35; transform: translateY(3px); } }

      .export-setting-row {

      .export-number-with-suffix .export-select { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }
      .export-width-unit-suffix { flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; direction: ltr; }
      .export-check-control {

      #exportDownloadBtn.download-error-state .download-motion-error path { animation: rampDownloadErrorDraw .34s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) .08s forwards; }
      @keyframes rampDownloadErrorDraw { from { stroke-dashoffset: 1; } to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }

    source = source.replace('</style>', `${exportDropdownCSS}</style>`);

    function buildRampGlb(geometry, rampType, unit) {
      if (!geometry?.points?.length || geometry.points.length < 2) {

      const scale = unit === 'centimeter' ? 100 : 1;
      const unitName = unit === 'centimeter' ? 'centimeter' : 'meter';
      const halfWidth = (Number(geometry.widthM) || (rampType === 'car' ? 3.5 : 1.2)) * scale / 2;
      const thickness = 0.15 * scale;
      const points = geometry.points.map(point => ({
        x: Number(point.x) * scale,
        y: Number(point.z) * scale
      }));
      const positions = [];
      const normals = [];

      const addTriangle = (a, b, c) => {
        const ab = [b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]];
        const ac = [c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1], c[2] - a[2]];
        let nx = ab[1] * ac[2] - ab[2] * ac[1];
        let ny = ab[2] * ac[0] - ab[0] * ac[2];
        let nz = ab[0] * ac[1] - ab[1] * ac[0];
        const length = Math.hypot(nx, ny, nz) || 1;
        nx /= length; ny /= length; nz /= length;
        positions.push(...a, ...b, ...c);
        normals.push(nx, ny, nz, nx, ny, nz, nx, ny, nz);
      };
      const addQuad = (a, b, c, d) => {
        addTriangle(a, b, c);
        addTriangle(a, c, d);
      };

      for (let i = 0; i < points.length - 1; i += 1) {
        const a = points[i];
        const b = points[i + 1];
        const atL = [a.x, a.y, -halfWidth];
        const atR = [a.x, a.y, halfWidth];
        const abL = [a.x, a.y - thickness, -halfWidth];
        const abR = [a.x, a.y - thickness, halfWidth];
        const btL = [b.x, b.y, -halfWidth];
        const btR = [b.x, b.y, halfWidth];
        const bbL = [b.x, b.y - thickness, -halfWidth];
        const bbR = [b.x, b.y - thickness, halfWidth];
        addQuad(atL, atR, btR, btL);
        addQuad(abR, abL, bbL, bbR);
        addQuad(abL, atL, btL, bbL);
        addQuad(atR, abR, bbR, btR);
      }

      const first = points[0];
      const last = points[points.length - 1];
      addQuad(
        [first.x, first.y, halfWidth],
        [first.x, first.y, -halfWidth],
        [first.x, first.y - thickness, -halfWidth],
        [first.x, first.y - thickness, halfWidth]
      );
      addQuad(
        [last.x, last.y, -halfWidth],
        [last.x, last.y, halfWidth],
        [last.x, last.y - thickness, halfWidth],
        [last.x, last.y - thickness, -halfWidth]
      );

      const positionArray = new Float32Array(positions);
      const normalArray = new Float32Array(normals);
      const positionBytes = new Uint8Array(positionArray.buffer);
      const normalBytes = new Uint8Array(normalArray.buffer);
      const binary = new Uint8Array(positionBytes.byteLength + normalBytes.byteLength);
      binary.set(positionBytes, 0);
      binary.set(normalBytes, positionBytes.byteLength);

      const xs = positions.filter((_, index) => index % 3 === 0);
      const ys = positions.filter((_, index) => index % 3 === 1);
      const zs = positions.filter((_, index) => index % 3 === 2);
      const gltf = {
        asset: {
          version: '2.0',
          generator: 'Pixel Architecture Studio Ramp Calculator',
          extras: { unit: unitName, metersPerUnit: unitName === 'meter' ? 1 : 0.01 }
        },
        scene: 0,
        scenes: [{ nodes: [0] }],
        nodes: [{ mesh: 0, name: 'Ramp', extras: { unit: unitName } }],
        meshes: [{
          name: 'Ramp 3D',
          primitives: [{ attributes: { POSITION: 0, NORMAL: 1 }, material: 0, mode: 4 }]
        }],
        materials: [{
          name: 'Ramp Concrete',
          pbrMetallicRoughness: {
            baseColorFactor: [0.42, 0.56, 0.92, 1],
            metallicFactor: 0,
            roughnessFactor: 0.72
          },
          doubleSided: false
        }],
        buffers: [{ byteLength: binary.byteLength }],
        bufferViews: [
          { buffer: 0, byteOffset: 0, byteLength: positionBytes.byteLength, target: 34962 },
          { buffer: 0, byteOffset: positionBytes.byteLength, byteLength: normalBytes.byteLength, target: 34962 }
        ],
        accessors: [
          {
            bufferView: 0, componentType: 5126, count: positions.length / 3, type: 'VEC3',
            min: [Math.min(...xs), Math.min(...ys), Math.min(...zs)],
            max: [Math.max(...xs), Math.max(...ys), Math.max(...zs)]
          },
          { bufferView: 1, componentType: 5126, count: normals.length / 3, type: 'VEC3' }
        ]
      };

      const encoder = new TextEncoder();
      const jsonRaw = encoder.encode(JSON.stringify(gltf));
      const jsonLength = Math.ceil(jsonRaw.byteLength / 4) * 4;
      const binLength = Math.ceil(binary.byteLength / 4) * 4;
      const totalLength = 12 + 8 + jsonLength + 8 + binLength;
      const glb = new ArrayBuffer(totalLength);
      const view = new DataView(glb);
      const output = new Uint8Array(glb);
      view.setUint32(0, 0x46546c67, true);
      view.setUint32(4, 2, true);
      view.setUint32(8, totalLength, true);
      view.setUint32(12, jsonLength, true);
      view.setUint32(16, 0x4e4f534a, true);
      output.fill(0x20, 20, 20 + jsonLength);
      output.set(jsonRaw, 20);
      const binHeader = 20 + jsonLength;
      view.setUint32(binHeader, binLength, true);
      view.setUint32(binHeader + 4, 0x004e4942, true);
      output.set(binary, binHeader + 8);
      return new Blob([glb], { type: 'model/gltf-binary' });
    }

    function buildRampDxf3D(geometry, rampType, unit, thicknessCm = 15, solid = true, widthValue = null) {
      if (!geometry?.points?.length || geometry.points.length < 2) {
        throw new Error('Ramp geometry is not available');
      }
      const scale = unit === 'centimeter' ? 100 : 1;
      const defaultWidth = (Number(geometry.widthM) || (rampType === 'car' ? 3.5 : 1.2)) * scale;
      const width = Number.isFinite(Number(widthValue)) && Number(widthValue) > 0 ? Number(widthValue) : defaultWidth;
      const halfWidth = width / 2;
      const thickness = Math.max(0.1, Number(thicknessCm) || 15) / 100 * scale;
      const points = geometry.points.map(point => ({ x: Number(point.x) * scale, z: Number(point.z) * scale }));
      const entities = [];
      const value = number => Number(number.toFixed(6));
      const face = (a, b, c, d, layer) => entities.push(`0\n3DFACE\n8\n${layer}\n10\n${value(a[0])}\n20\n${value(a[1])}\n30\n${value(a[2])}\n11\n${value(b[0])}\n21\n${value(b[1])}\n31\n${value(b[2])}\n12\n${value(c[0])}\n22\n${value(c[1])}\n32\n${value(c[2])}\n13\n${value(d[0])}\n23\n${value(d[1])}\n33\n${value(d[2])}`);
      const quad = (a, b, c, d, layer) => {
        face(a, b, c, c, layer);
        face(a, c, d, d, layer);
      };

      for (let index = 0; index < points.length - 1; index += 1) {
        const a = points[index];
        const b = points[index + 1];
        const topAL = [a.x, -halfWidth, a.z];
        const topAR = [a.x, halfWidth, a.z];
        const topBL = [b.x, -halfWidth, b.z];
        const topBR = [b.x, halfWidth, b.z];
        quad(topAL, topBL, topBR, topAR, 'RAMP_TOP');
        if (solid) {
          const botAL = [a.x, -halfWidth, a.z - thickness];
          const botAR = [a.x, halfWidth, a.z - thickness];
          const botBL = [b.x, -halfWidth, b.z - thickness];
          const botBR = [b.x, halfWidth, b.z - thickness];
          quad(botAR, botBR, botBL, botAL, 'RAMP_BOTTOM');
          quad(botAL, botBL, topBL, topAL, 'RAMP_LEFT');
          quad(topAR, topBR, botBR, botAR, 'RAMP_RIGHT');
        }
      }

      if (solid) {
        const first = points[0];
        const last = points[points.length - 1];
        quad(
          [first.x, halfWidth, first.z], [first.x, -halfWidth, first.z],
          [first.x, -halfWidth, first.z - thickness], [first.x, halfWidth, first.z - thickness], 'RAMP_END'
        );
        quad(
          [last.x, -halfWidth, last.z], [last.x, halfWidth, last.z],
          [last.x, halfWidth, last.z - thickness], [last.x, -halfWidth, last.z - thickness], 'RAMP_END'
        );
      }

      const insUnits = unit === 'centimeter' ? 5 : 6;
      const dxf = `0\nSECTION\n2\nHEADER\n9\n$INSUNITS\n70\n${insUnits}\n0\nENDSEC\n0\nSECTION\n2\nENTITIES\n${entities.join('\n')}\n0\nENDSEC\n0\nEOF\n`;
      return new Blob([dxf], { type: 'application/dxf' });
    }

    // The unified Export modal is created by the existing load handler.

              </button>

                  <span class="export-format-option-copy">

              </button>

              <div class="export-format-scroll-cue" id="exportFormatScrollCue" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></div>
            </div>`;

          body.insertBefore(field, oldSwitch);

          const jpgPanel = doc.createElement('div');
          jpgPanel.className = 'export-settings-panel';
          jpgPanel.dataset.exportPanel = 'jpg';
          jpgPanel.innerHTML = `
            <div class="export-setting-row">

              <div class="export-number-with-suffix"><input class="export-select" id="exportJpgWidth" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" value="3.5" inputmode="decimal"><span class="export-width-unit-suffix" id="exportJpgWidthSuffix">m</span></div>
            </div>

            <div class="export-setting-row" id="exportJpgWidthUnitRow">

              <select class="export-select" id="exportJpgWidthUnit" aria-label="واحد اندازه‌ها">
                <option value="m" selected>متر (m)</option>
                <option value="cm">سانتی‌متر (cm)</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div class="export-setting-row">
              <div class="export-setting-copy">
                <div class="export-setting-label" id="exportJpgQualityLabel">کیفیت</div>
                <div class="export-setting-hint" id="exportJpgQualityHint">رزولوشن تصویر خروجی</div>
              </div>
              <select class="export-select" id="exportJpgQuality">
                <option value="minimum">Minimum (72 DPI · کمترین حجم)</option>
                <option value="low">Low (96 DPI · فایل سبک)</option>
                <option value="medium">Medium (144 DPI · استفاده عمومی)</option>
                <option value="high" selected>High (240 DPI · چاپ باکیفیت)</option>
                <option value="maximum">Maximum (300 DPI · حداکثر جزئیات)</option>

            </div>`;
          body.appendChild(jpgPanel);
          // JPG settings are injected dynamically; bind their pointer position
          // directly so the edge highlight works on every control.
          jpgPanel.querySelectorAll('.export-setting-row, .export-select').forEach(control => {
            control.addEventListener('pointermove', event => {

          const dxf3dPanel = doc.createElement('div');

              <div class="export-number-with-suffix"><input class="export-select" id="exportDxf3dWidth" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" value="350" inputmode="decimal"><span class="export-width-unit-suffix" id="exportDxf3dWidthSuffix">cm</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="export-setting-row">
              <div class="export-setting-copy">

              <select class="export-select" id="exportDxf3dGeometry">
                <option value="solid" selected>مدل با ضخامت حجم</option>

            </div>
            <div id="exportDxf3dThicknessRow" class="export-setting-row">
              <div class="export-setting-copy">
                <div class="export-setting-label" id="exportDxf3dThicknessLabel">ضخامت رمپ</div>
                <div class="export-setting-hint" id="exportDxf3dThicknessHint">ضخامت مدل رمپ در مدل</div>
              </div>
              <div class="export-number-with-suffix"><input class="export-select" id="exportDxf3dThickness" type="number" min="0.001" step="0.01" value="40" inputmode="decimal"><span class="export-width-unit-suffix" id="exportDxf3dThicknessSuffix">cm</span></div>
            </div>`;
          body.appendChild(dxf3dPanel);
          // DXF 3D settings are also injected dynamically; bind pointer
          // coordinates directly so every edge highlight follows the cursor.
          dxf3dPanel.querySelectorAll('.export-setting-row, .export-select').forEach(control => {
            control.addEventListener('pointermove', event => {
              const rect = control.getBoundingClientRect();
              control.style.setProperty('--mx', `${event.clientX - rect.left}px`);
              control.style.setProperty('--my', `${event.clientY - rect.top}px`);

          });

          // Keep the dimension unit immediately before ramp width in every
          // format panel for a consistent reading order.
          const placeUnitBeforeWidth = (unitRowId, widthRowId) => {
            const unitRow = modal.querySelector(`#${unitRowId}`);
            const widthRow = modal.querySelector(`#${widthRowId}`);
            if (unitRow && widthRow && widthRow.parentNode) {
              widthRow.parentNode.insertBefore(unitRow, widthRow);
            }
          };
          placeUnitBeforeWidth('exportPdfWidthUnitRow', 'exportPdfWidthRow');
          placeUnitBeforeWidth('exportJpgWidthUnitRow', 'exportJpgWidthRow');

          const picker = field.querySelector('#exportFormatPicker');
          const menu = field.querySelector('#exportFormatMenu');
          const badge = field.querySelector('#exportFormatBadge');
          const icon = field.querySelector('#exportFormatIcon');
          const title = field.querySelector('#exportFormatTitle');
          const hint = field.querySelector('#exportFormatHint');
          const choices = [...field.querySelectorAll('[data-format-choice]')];
          const scrollCue = field.querySelector('#exportFormatScrollCue');
          const jpgView = jpgPanel.querySelector('#exportJpgView');
          const jpgWidth = jpgPanel.querySelector('#exportJpgWidth');
          const jpgWidthUnit = jpgPanel.querySelector('#exportJpgWidthUnit');
          const jpgWidthRow = jpgPanel.querySelector('#exportJpgWidthRow');
          const jpgQuality = jpgPanel.querySelector('#exportJpgQuality');
          const dxf3dUnit = dxf3dPanel.querySelector('#exportDxf3dUnit');
          const dxf3dWidth = dxf3dPanel.querySelector('#exportDxf3dWidth');
          const dxf3dThickness = dxf3dPanel.querySelector('#exportDxf3dThickness');
          const dxf3dGeometry = dxf3dPanel.querySelector('#exportDxf3dGeometry');
          const dxf3dThicknessRow = dxf3dPanel.querySelector('#exportDxf3dThicknessRow');
          let selectedFormat = 'pdf';
          const syncJpgWidthVisibility = () => {
            const includesPlan = jpgView.value === 'plan' || jpgView.value === 'both';
            jpgWidthRow?.classList.toggle('is-muted', !includesPlan);
            if (jpgWidth) jpgWidth.disabled = !includesPlan;
          };
          jpgView.addEventListener('change', syncJpgWidthVisibility);
          let jpgWidthPreviousUnit = jpgWidthUnit?.value || 'm';
          jpgWidthUnit?.addEventListener('change', () => {
            const numericWidth = Number(jpgWidth?.value);
            if (!Number.isFinite(numericWidth) || numericWidth <= 0) {
              jpgWidthPreviousUnit = jpgWidthUnit.value;
              return;
            }
            const widthM = jpgWidthPreviousUnit === 'cm' ? numericWidth / 100 : numericWidth;
            jpgWidth.value = jpgWidthUnit.value === 'cm'
              ? Number((widthM * 100).toFixed(2))
              : Number(widthM.toFixed(3));
            jpgWidthPreviousUnit = jpgWidthUnit.value;
          });
          try {
            const api = frame.contentWindow.rampExportAPI;
            const geometry = api?.geometry?.();
            const fallbackWidth = api?.type?.() === 'car' ? 3.5 : 1.2;
            const widthM = Number(geometry?.widthM) || fallbackWidth;
            if (jpgWidth) jpgWidth.value = Number(widthM.toFixed(3));
            if (jpgWidthUnit) jpgWidthUnit.value = 'm';
          } catch (_) { /* keep the safe default */ }
          try {
            const api = frame.contentWindow.rampExportAPI;
            const geometry = api?.geometry?.();
            const fallbackWidth = api?.type?.() === 'car' ? 3.5 : 1.2;
            const widthM = Number(geometry?.widthM) || fallbackWidth;
            if (dxf3dWidth) dxf3dWidth.value = Number((widthM * 100).toFixed(2));
          } catch (_) { /* keep the safe default */ }

          const isEnglish = () => doc.documentElement.dataset.lang === 'en';
          const copy = {

          const closeMenu = () => {
            menu.classList.remove('open');
            menu.classList.remove('flip-up');
            picker.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          };
          const updateMenuScrollCue = () => {
            if (!scrollCue) return;
            const overflow = menu.scrollHeight > menu.clientHeight + 2;
            const atBottom = menu.scrollTop + menu.clientHeight >= menu.scrollHeight - 2;
            scrollCue.classList.toggle('visible', overflow && !atBottom);
          };
          menu.addEventListener('scroll', updateMenuScrollCue, { passive: true });
          const openMenu = () => {
            const pickerRect = picker.getBoundingClientRect();
            const availableBelow = window.innerHeight - pickerRect.bottom - 16;
            const availableAbove = pickerRect.top - 16;
            menu.classList.toggle('flip-up', availableBelow < 180 && availableAbove > availableBelow);
            menu.classList.add('open');
            picker.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
            requestAnimationFrame(updateMenuScrollCue);
          };

          picker.addEventListener('click', event => {
            event.stopPropagation();
            menu.classList.contains('open') ? closeMenu() : openMenu();
          });
          menu.addEventListener('click', event => event.stopPropagation());
          doc.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);

          const syncJpgDefaultView = () => {
            const activeView = doc.querySelector('.view-tab.active')?.dataset.view;
            if (activeView === 'section' || activeView === 'plan') jpgView.value = activeView;
          };

          const applyFormat = format => {
            selectedFormat = ['pdf','jpg','dxf','dxf3d'].includes(format) ? format : 'pdf';

            choices.forEach(option => {
              const active = option.dataset.formatChoice === selectedFormat;
              option.classList.toggle('selected', active);
              option.setAttribute('aria-selected', active ? 'true' : 'false');
            });

            const displayFormatName = selectedFormat === 'dxf3d' ? 'DXF 3D' : selectedFormat.toUpperCase();
            badge.textContent = displayFormatName;
            title.textContent = displayFormatName;
            const selectedIcon = choices.find(option => option.dataset.formatChoice === selectedFormat)?.querySelector('.export-format-icon');
            if (icon && selectedIcon) icon.innerHTML = selectedIcon.innerHTML;

            const c = isEnglish() ? copy.en : copy.fa;
            hint.textContent = selectedFormat === 'pdf' ? c.pdfHint : selectedFormat === 'jpg' ? c.jpgHint : selectedFormat === 'dxf' ? c.dxfHint : c.dxf3dHint;

            // The original PDF/DXF switch only knows about its two initial panels.
            // Clear every current panel first so dynamically added JPG panels
            // cannot remain active when returning to PDF, DXF, or DXF 3D.
            modal.querySelectorAll('.export-settings-panel').forEach(panel => panel.classList.remove('active'));

            if (selectedFormat === 'pdf' || selectedFormat === 'dxf') {
              const hiddenButton = oldSwitch.querySelector(`[data-export-format="${selectedFormat}"]`);
              hiddenButton?.click();
            } else if (selectedFormat === 'dxf3d') {
              dxf3dPanel.classList.add('active');
              downloadLabel.textContent = c.downloadDxf3d;
              downloadBtn.disabled = false;
            } else if (selectedFormat === 'jpg') {
              jpgPanel.classList.add('active');
              syncJpgDefaultView();
              syncJpgWidthVisibility();
              downloadLabel.textContent = c.downloadJpg;
              downloadBtn.disabled = false;
            }

            closeMenu();
          };

          choices.forEach(option => option.addEventListener('click', () => applyFormat(option.dataset.formatChoice)));

          const updateLanguage = () => {
            const c = isEnglish() ? copy.en : copy.fa;
            doc.querySelector('#exportFormatFieldLabel').textContent = c.format;
            field.querySelector('[data-format-hint="pdf"]').textContent = c.pdfHint;
            field.querySelector('[data-format-hint="jpg"]').textContent = c.jpgHint;
            field.querySelector('[data-format-hint="dxf"]').textContent = c.dxfHint;
            field.querySelector('[data-format-hint="dxf3d"]').textContent = c.dxf3dHint;
            hint.textContent = selectedFormat === 'pdf' ? c.pdfHint : selectedFormat === 'jpg' ? c.jpgHint : selectedFormat === 'dxf' ? c.dxfHint : c.dxf3dHint;
            doc.querySelector('#exportJpgViewLabel').textContent = c.viewLabel;
            doc.querySelector('#exportJpgViewHint').textContent = c.viewHint;
            doc.querySelector('#exportJpgWidthLabel').textContent = c.jpgWidthLabel;
            doc.querySelector('#exportJpgWidthHint').textContent = c.jpgWidthHint;
            doc.querySelector('#exportJpgQualityLabel').textContent = c.jpgQualityLabel;
            doc.querySelector('#exportJpgQualityHint').textContent = c.jpgQualityHint;
            jpgView.options[0].textContent = c.plan;
            jpgView.options[1].textContent = c.section;
            jpgView.options[2].textContent = c.both;
            jpgQuality.options[0].textContent = c.minimum;
            jpgQuality.options[1].textContent = c.low;
            jpgQuality.options[2].textContent = c.medium;
            jpgQuality.options[3].textContent = c.high;
            jpgQuality.options[4].textContent = c.maximum;
            if (jpgWidthUnit) {
              jpgWidthUnit.options[0].textContent = c.meter;
              jpgWidthUnit.options[1].textContent = c.centimeter;
            }
            doc.querySelector('#exportDxf3dUnitLabel').textContent = c.dxf3dUnitLabel;
            doc.querySelector('#exportDxf3dUnitHint').textContent = c.dxf3dUnitHint;
            doc.querySelector('#exportDxf3dWidthLabel').textContent = c.dxf3dWidthLabel;
            doc.querySelector('#exportDxf3dWidthHint').textContent = c.dxf3dWidthHint;
            doc.querySelector('#exportDxf3dThicknessLabel').textContent = c.dxf3dThicknessLabel;
            doc.querySelector('#exportDxf3dThicknessHint').textContent = c.dxf3dThicknessHint;
            dxf3dUnit.options[0].textContent = c.meter;
            dxf3dUnit.options[1].textContent = c.centimeter;
            doc.querySelector('#exportDxf3dGeometryLabel').textContent = c.dxf3dGeometryLabel;
            doc.querySelector('#exportDxf3dGeometryHint').textContent = c.dxf3dGeometryHint;
            dxf3dGeometry.options[0].textContent = c.dxf3dSolid;
            dxf3dGeometry.options[1].textContent = c.dxf3dSurface;
            if (selectedFormat === 'jpg') downloadLabel.textContent = c.downloadJpg;
            if (selectedFormat === 'dxf3d') downloadLabel.textContent = c.downloadDxf3d;
            if (typeof syncDxf3dThickness === 'function') syncDxf3dThickness();
          };

          const syncDxf3dThickness = () => {
            const hasThickness = dxf3dGeometry.value === 'solid';
            dxf3dThickness.disabled = !hasThickness;
            dxf3dThicknessRow.classList.toggle('is-muted', !hasThickness);
            const unitIsMeter = dxf3dUnit.value === 'meter';
            dxf3dThickness.title = isEnglish()
              ? (unitIsMeter ? 'Thickness in meters' : 'Thickness in centimeters')
              : (unitIsMeter ? 'ضخامت بر حسب متر' : 'ضخامت بر حسب سانتی‌متر');
            if (dxf3dThicknessHint) {
              dxf3dThicknessHint.textContent = isEnglish()
                ? 'Ramp model thickness in the model'
                : 'ضخامت مدل رمپ در مدل';
            }
          };
          const dxf3dThicknessHint = dxf3dPanel.querySelector('#exportDxf3dThicknessHint');
          let dxf3dPreviousUnit = dxf3dUnit.value;
          dxf3dUnit.addEventListener('change', () => {
            const numericValue = Number(dxf3dThickness.value);
            const thicknessCm = dxf3dPreviousUnit === 'meter' ? numericValue * 100 : numericValue;
            dxf3dThickness.value = dxf3dUnit.value === 'meter'
              ? (thicknessCm / 100).toFixed(3).replace(/\.000$/, '')
              : Number(thicknessCm.toFixed(3));
            const numericWidth = Number(dxf3dWidth.value);
            if (Number.isFinite(numericWidth) && numericWidth > 0) {
              const widthM = dxf3dPreviousUnit === 'meter' ? numericWidth : numericWidth / 100;
              dxf3dWidth.value = dxf3dUnit.value === 'meter'
                ? Number(widthM.toFixed(3))
                : Number((widthM * 100).toFixed(2));
            }
            const widthSuffix = dxf3dPanel.querySelector('#exportDxf3dWidthSuffix');
            if (widthSuffix) widthSuffix.textContent = dxf3dUnit.value === 'meter' ? 'm' : 'cm';
            const thicknessSuffix = dxf3dPanel.querySelector('#exportDxf3dThicknessSuffix');
            if (thicknessSuffix) thicknessSuffix.textContent = dxf3dUnit.value === 'meter' ? 'm' : 'cm';
            dxf3dPreviousUnit = dxf3dUnit.value;
            syncDxf3dThickness();
          });
          dxf3dGeometry.addEventListener('change', () => {
            syncDxf3dThickness();
            updateLanguage();
          });
          syncDxf3dThickness();

          // JPG and DXF 3D get dedicated download paths; PDF and DXF use the existing engines.
          downloadBtn.addEventListener('click', async event => {
            if (selectedFormat !== 'jpg' && selectedFormat !== 'dxf3d') return;
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopImmediatePropagation();
            if (downloadBtn.disabled) return;

            if (selectedFormat === 'dxf3d') {
              const api = frame.contentWindow.rampExportAPI;
              if (!api || typeof api.geometry !== 'function') {
                showDownloadErrorAnimation('#exportDownloadBtn');
                const toast = frame.contentWindow.__rampShowUnifiedDownloadToast;
                if (typeof toast === 'function') toast('error');
                return;
              }
              try {
                api.refresh?.();
                if (!api.valid()) {
                  showDownloadErrorAnimation('#exportDownloadBtn');
                  const toast = frame.contentWindow.__rampShowUnifiedDownloadToast;
                  if (typeof toast === 'function') toast('error');
                  return;
                }
                downloadBtn.disabled = true;
                const solid = dxf3dGeometry.value === 'solid';
                const widthInputValue = Number(dxf3dWidth.value);
                const widthM = dxf3dUnit.value === 'meter' ? widthInputValue : widthInputValue / 100;
                const widthForModelUnit = dxf3dUnit.value === 'meter' ? widthM : widthM * 100;
                const blob = buildRampDxf3D(api.geometry(), api.type(), dxf3dUnit.value, dxf3dThickness.value, solid, widthForModelUnit);
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = doc.createElement('a');
                const date = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
                a.href = url;
                a.download = `ramp-3d-${api.type()}-${solid ? 'solid' : 'surface'}-${dxf3dUnit.value}-${date}.dxf`;
                doc.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                a.remove();
                setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
                const motion = frame.contentWindow.__rampShowDownloadSuccessAnimation;
                if (typeof motion === 'function') motion('#exportDownloadBtn');
                else if (typeof showDownloadSuccessAnimation === 'function') showDownloadSuccessAnimation('#exportDownloadBtn');
                const toast = frame.contentWindow.__rampShowUnifiedDownloadToast;
                if (typeof toast === 'function') toast('success');
              } catch (error) {
                console.error('DXF 3D export failed:', error);
                showDownloadErrorAnimation('#exportDownloadBtn');
                const toast = frame.contentWindow.__rampShowUnifiedDownloadToast;
                if (typeof toast === 'function') toast('error');
              } finally {
                downloadBtn.disabled = false;
              }
              return;
            }

            const renderer = frame.contentWindow.__rampRenderTechnicalSheetToJpeg;
            if (typeof renderer !== 'function') {
              showDownloadErrorAnimation('#exportDownloadBtn');
              const toast = frame.contentWindow.__rampShowUnifiedDownloadToast;
              if (typeof toast === 'function') toast('error');
              return;
            }

            downloadBtn.disabled = true;
            const previousPdfQuality = pdfQuality?.value;
            try {
              if (pdfQuality) pdfQuality.value = jpgQuality.value;
              let page;
              if (jpgView.value === 'both') {
                const [sectionPage, planPage] = await Promise.all([
                  renderer('section'),
                  renderer('plan')
                ]);
                const loadPageImage = rendered => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                  const imageBlob = new Blob([rendered.bytes], { type: 'image/jpeg' });
                  const imageUrl = URL.createObjectURL(imageBlob);
                  const image = new frame.contentWindow.Image();
                  image.onload = () => {
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl);
                    resolve(image);
                  };
                  image.onerror = () => {
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl);
                    reject(new Error('Combined JPG image load failed'));
                  };
                  image.src = imageUrl;
                });
                const [sectionImage, planImage] = await Promise.all([
                  loadPageImage(sectionPage),
                  loadPageImage(planPage)
                ]);
                const combinedCanvas = doc.createElement('canvas');
                combinedCanvas.width = sectionPage.width;
                combinedCanvas.height = sectionPage.height;
                const combinedCtx = combinedCanvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
                combinedCtx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                combinedCtx.fillRect(0, 0, combinedCanvas.width, combinedCanvas.height);
                const gap = Math.max(16, Math.round(Math.min(combinedCanvas.width, combinedCanvas.height) * 0.012));
                const padding = gap;
                const slots = [
                  { x: padding, y: padding, w: (combinedCanvas.width - padding * 2 - gap) / 2, h: combinedCanvas.height - padding * 2 },
                  { x: padding + (combinedCanvas.width - padding * 2 + gap) / 2, y: padding, w: (combinedCanvas.width - padding * 2 - gap) / 2, h: combinedCanvas.height - padding * 2 }
                ];
                [sectionImage, planImage].forEach((image, index) => {
                  const slot = slots[index];
                  const scale = Math.min(slot.w / image.width, slot.h / image.height);
                  const width = image.width * scale;
                  const height = image.height * scale;
                  combinedCtx.drawImage(image, slot.x + (slot.w - width) / 2, slot.y + (slot.h - height) / 2, width, height);
                });
                const jpgQualityValue = jpgQuality.value === 'maximum' ? 0.98 : jpgQuality.value === 'high' ? 0.94 : jpgQuality.value === 'medium' ? 0.88 : jpgQuality.value === 'low' ? 0.8 : 0.72;
                const combinedBlob = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => combinedCanvas.toBlob(
                  blob => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error('Combined JPG render failed')),
                  'image/jpeg',
                  jpgQualityValue
                ));
                page = { bytes: new Uint8Array(await combinedBlob.arrayBuffer()) };
              } else {
                page = await renderer(jpgView.value);
              }
              const blob = new Blob([page.bytes], { type: 'image/jpeg' });
              const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
              const a = doc.createElement('a');
              const date = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
              a.href = url;
              a.download = `ramp-technical-A-series-${jpgView.value}-${date}.jpg`;
              doc.body.appendChild(a);
              a.click();
              a.remove();
              setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);

              const motion = frame.contentWindow.__rampShowDownloadSuccessAnimation;
              if (typeof motion === 'function') motion('#exportDownloadBtn');
              else if (typeof showDownloadSuccessAnimation === 'function') showDownloadSuccessAnimation('#exportDownloadBtn');
              const toast = frame.contentWindow.__rampShowUnifiedDownloadToast;
              if (typeof toast === 'function') toast('success');
            } catch (error) {
              console.error(error);
              showDownloadErrorAnimation('#exportDownloadBtn');
              const toast = frame.contentWindow.__rampShowUnifiedDownloadToast;
              if (typeof toast === 'function') toast('error');
            } finally {
              if (pdfQuality && previousPdfQuality != null) pdfQuality.value = previousPdfQuality;
              downloadBtn.disabled = false;
            }
          }, true);

          const langObserver = new MutationObserver(updateLanguage);
          langObserver.observe(doc.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-lang'] });

          updateLanguage();
          applyFormat('pdf');
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Export format dropdown setup failed:', error);
        }
      }, 0);
    }, { once: true });

    source = source.replace('      function buildRampGeometry(r) {', `      window.rampExportAPI = {
        valid: () => !!state.result?.valid && !state.result?.blocked,
        refresh: () => calculateCurrent(true),
        geometry: () => buildRampGeometry(state.result),
        sheet: view => buildTechnicalSheetSVG(view),
        jpeg: view => renderTechnicalSheetToJpeg(view),
        pdf: pages => buildA4Pdf(pages),
        dxf: () => downloadDXF(),
        type: () => state.type,
        setType: type => {
          if (!["car", "disabled", "human"].includes(type)) return;
          const changed = state.type !== type;
          setType(type);
          if (!changed) return;
          const defaults = {
            car: {
              "#carHeight": "350",
              "#carSlope": "15",
              "#carTransition": "10",
              "#carAfterRamp3m": true
            },
            disabled: {
              "#disabledHeight": "120",
              "#disabledSlope": "8",
              "#disabledRegulations": true,
              "#disabledCompanion": true
            },
            human: {
              "#humanHeight": "120",
              "#humanSlope": "12"
            }
          };
          Object.entries(defaults[type]).forEach(([selector, value]) => {
            const input = $(selector);
            if (!input) return;
            if (input.type === "checkbox") input.checked = Boolean(value);
            else input.value = value;
          });
          state.heightUnit = "cm";
          applyHeightUnitAttributes("cm");
          // Render the selected tab's default geometry immediately. The
          // calculation remains uncommitted until the Calculate button is used.
          calculateCurrent(false);
        },
        view: () => state.view,
        setView: view => setView(view)
      };
      function buildRampGeometry(r) {`);
    // Fixed ISO A-series aspect ratio for print-safe PDF and JPG output.
    source = source.replace(
      `          // اندازه A4 افقی بر اساس کیفیت انتخاب‌شده در پنجره Export
          const exportPdfQuality = document.querySelector("#exportPdfQuality")?.value || "high";
          const exportPdfHighQuality = exportPdfQuality !== "standard";
          canvas.width = exportPdfHighQuality ? 2806 : 1684;
          canvas.height = exportPdfHighQuality ? 1984 : 1190;`,
      `          const activeExportFormat = (document.querySelector("#exportFormatBadge")?.textContent || "PDF").trim().toLowerCase();
          const settingPrefix = activeExportFormat === "jpg" ? "Jpg" : "Pdf";
          const quality = document.querySelector(\`#export\${settingPrefix}Quality\`)?.value || "high";
          const dpi = { minimum: 72, low: 96, medium: 144, high: 240, maximum: 300 }[quality] || 240;
          canvas.width = Math.round(297 / 25.4 * dpi);
          canvas.height = Math.round(210 / 25.4 * dpi);`
    );

    source = source.replace(
      `          ctx.drawImage(image, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);`,
      `          const fitScale = Math.min(canvas.width / image.width, canvas.height / image.height);
          const drawWidth = Math.round(image.width * fitScale);
          const drawHeight = Math.round(image.height * fitScale);
          const drawX = Math.round((canvas.width - drawWidth) / 2);
          const drawY = Math.round((canvas.height - drawHeight) / 2);
          ctx.drawImage(image, drawX, drawY, drawWidth, drawHeight);`
    );

    source = source.replace(
      `              exportPdfHighQuality ? 0.96 : 0.86`,
      `              quality === "maximum" ? 0.98 : quality === "high" ? 0.94 : quality === "medium" ? 0.88 : quality === "low" ? 0.8 : 0.72`
    );

    source = source
      .replace('pushText("%PDF-1.4\\n%TECH-A4\\n");', 'pushText("%PDF-1.4\\n%TECH-ISO-A-SERIES\\n");')
      .replace(
        '`ramp-technical-A4-${state.type}-${exportViews.join("-")}-${date}.pdf`',
        '`ramp-technical-A-series-${state.type}-${exportViews.join("-")}-${date}.pdf`'
      );

    // Keep quality labels stable and identical in preview and downloaded HTML.
    frame.addEventListener('load', () => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        const doc = frame.contentDocument;
        const modal = doc.querySelector('#exportModal');
        if (!modal || modal.dataset.qualityOptionsReady === 'true') return;
        modal.dataset.qualityOptionsReady = 'true';

        const qualityMarkup = '<option value="minimum">Minimum (72 DPI · کمترین حجم)</option><option value="low">Low (96 DPI · فایل سبک)</option><option value="medium">Medium (144 DPI · استفاده عمومی)</option><option value="high" selected>High (240 DPI · چاپ باکیفیت)</option><option value="maximum">Maximum (300 DPI · حداکثر جزئیات)</option>';

        ['Pdf', 'Jpg'].forEach(prefix => {
          const panel = modal.querySelector(`[data-export-panel="${prefix.toLowerCase()}"]`);
          const quality = modal.querySelector(`#export${prefix}Quality`);
          if (!panel || !quality) return;
          quality.innerHTML = qualityMarkup;
          panel.querySelector('.export-meta')?.remove();
        });

        const updateQualityLanguage = () => {
          const en = doc.documentElement.dataset.lang === 'en';
          ['Pdf', 'Jpg'].forEach(prefix => {
            const quality = modal.querySelector(`#export${prefix}Quality`);
            if (quality) {
              quality.options[0].textContent = en ? 'Minimum (smallest file · 72 DPI)' : 'Minimum (72 DPI · کمترین حجم)';
              quality.options[1].textContent = en ? 'Low (lightweight · 96 DPI)' : 'Low (96 DPI · فایل سبک)';
              quality.options[2].textContent = en ? 'Medium (general use · 144 DPI)' : 'Medium (144 DPI · استفاده عمومی)';
              quality.options[3].textContent = en ? 'High (quality print · 240 DPI)' : 'High (240 DPI · چاپ باکیفیت)';
              quality.options[4].textContent = en ? 'Maximum (maximum detail · 300 DPI)' : 'Maximum (300 DPI · حداکثر جزئیات)';
            }
          });
        };

        new MutationObserver(updateQualityLanguage).observe(doc.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-lang'] });
        updateQualityLanguage();
      }, 20);
    }, { once: true });


    frame.addEventListener("load", () => {
      try {
        const doc = frame.contentDocument;

        // The history controls are shared by every ramp tab. Move the row out
        // of the car-only form section so it remains visible for accessible
        // and general ramps as well.
        const sharedHistoryRow = doc.querySelector('.history-switch-row');
        const sharedCalculateButton = doc.querySelector('#calculateBtn');
        const sharedFormCard = sharedCalculateButton?.parentElement;
        if (sharedHistoryRow && sharedCalculateButton && sharedFormCard) {
          sharedFormCard.insertBefore(sharedHistoryRow, sharedCalculateButton);
        }
        const parkingStopBox = doc.querySelector('.parking-stop-box');
        const syncParkingStopControl = () => {
          const currentType = frame.contentWindow.rampExportAPI?.type?.();
          if (parkingStopBox) parkingStopBox.style.display = currentType === 'car' ? '' : 'none';
        };
        syncParkingStopControl();

        // Calculate button state: keep the core calculation logic isolated.
        const calculateButton = doc.querySelector("#calculateBtn");
        if (calculateButton && !doc.querySelector("#calculationInputChangedNote")) {
          const note = doc.createElement("div");
          note.id = "calculationInputChangedNote";
          note.setAttribute("role", "status");
          note.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
          note.hidden = true;
          note.textContent = "ورودی‌ها تغییر کرده؛ دوباره محاسبه کنید.";
          calculateButton.parentNode.insertBefore(note, calculateButton);

          const style = doc.createElement("style");
          style.textContent = `#calculationInputChangedNote{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin:0 0 8px;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:750;line-height:1.7;text-align:right}#calculationInputChangedNote::before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;flex:0 0 7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 18%,transparent)}#calculationInputChangedNote[hidden]{display:none!important}#calculateBtn:disabled{opacity:.42;cursor:not-allowed;filter:saturate(.55)}.calculate-button-wrap{position:relative;width:100%}.calculate-button-tooltip{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:calc(100% + 8px);z-index:20;max-width:min(300px,calc(100vw - 32px));padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;background:var(--surface-solid);color:var(--text);font-size:11px;font-weight:750;line-height:1.7;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transform:translateY(4px);pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .16s ease,transform .16s ease,visibility .16s ease}.calculate-button-wrap.is-explaining .calculate-button-tooltip{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:translateY(0)}`;
          style.textContent += `#calculationInputChangedNote.is-dirty::before{display:block;animation:calculationNotePulse 1.1s ease-in-out infinite;will-change:transform,opacity,box-shadow}@keyframes calculationNotePulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:.65;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 20%,transparent)}50%{transform:scale(1.35);opacity:1;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 12%,transparent)}}`;
          doc.head.appendChild(style);

          const buttonWrap = doc.createElement("div");
          buttonWrap.className = "calculate-button-wrap";
          const tooltip = doc.createElement("div");
          tooltip.className = "calculate-button-tooltip";
          tooltip.setAttribute("role", "tooltip");
          tooltip.textContent = "برای جلوگیری از محاسبه تکراری خاموش است؛ ابتدا یکی از ورودی‌ها را تغییر دهید.";
          buttonWrap.appendChild(tooltip);
          calculateButton.parentNode.insertBefore(buttonWrap, calculateButton);
          buttonWrap.appendChild(calculateButton);

          let hasCalculated = true;
          const sync = dirty => {
            calculateButton.disabled = hasCalculated && !dirty;
            note.hidden = !hasCalculated;
            note.classList.toggle("is-dirty", dirty);
            note.textContent = dirty
              ? "ورودی‌ها تغییر کرده؛ دوباره محاسبه کنید."
              : "نتیجه مطابق آخرین محاسبه است.";
            note.setAttribute("aria-hidden", String(note.hidden));
          };
          calculateButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
            hasCalculated = true;
            sync(false);
          }, true);
          const explainIfDisabled = () => buttonWrap.classList.toggle("is-explaining", calculateButton.disabled);
          buttonWrap.addEventListener("mouseenter", explainIfDisabled);
          buttonWrap.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => buttonWrap.classList.remove("is-explaining"));
          buttonWrap.addEventListener("focusin", explainIfDisabled);
          buttonWrap.addEventListener("focusout", () => buttonWrap.classList.remove("is-explaining"));
          doc.querySelectorAll("input, select").forEach(input => {
            input.addEventListener("input", () => { if (hasCalculated) sync(true); });
            input.addEventListener("change", () => { if (hasCalculated) sync(true); });
          });
          // Keep the existing calculation flow intact: show feedback first, then
          // replay the click once so the original app listener performs the work.
          const loadingStyle = doc.createElement("style");
          loadingStyle.id = "calculateLoadingStyle";
          loadingStyle.textContent = `#calculateBtn.is-calculating{cursor:wait!important;pointer-events:none;opacity:.92}#calculateBtn .calculate-loading-dots{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;min-width:31px;height:1em;vertical-align:middle}#calculateBtn .calculate-loading-dots i{display:block;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;opacity:.32;animation:calculateLoadingDot .72s ease-in-out infinite}#calculateBtn .calculate-loading-dots i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.12s}#calculateBtn .calculate-loading-dots i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.24s}@keyframes calculateLoadingDot{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:.3}50%{transform:translateY(-3px);opacity:1}}.drawing-area,.result-box{position:relative}.drawing-area.is-calculating #rampDrawing{filter:blur(2.4px);opacity:.62;transition:filter .18s ease,opacity .18s ease}.result-box.is-calculating > :not(.result-calculation-overlay){filter:blur(2.4px);opacity:.62;transition:filter .18s ease,opacity .18s ease}.drawing-calculation-overlay,.result-calculation-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:5;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:inherit;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--surface-solid) 12%,transparent);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .18s ease,visibility .18s ease}.drawing-area.is-calculating .drawing-calculation-overlay,.result-box.is-calculating .result-calculation-overlay{opacity:1;visibility:visible}.drawing-calculation-spinner,.result-calculation-spinner{width:27px;height:27px;border:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 25%,transparent);border-top-color:var(--accent);border-right-color:var(--accent);border-radius:50%;animation:drawingCalculationSpin .78s linear infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 8px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 25%,transparent))}@keyframes drawingCalculationSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.drawing-calculation-spinner,.result-calculation-spinner{animation:none}.drawing-area.is-calculating #rampDrawing,.result-box.is-calculating > :not(.result-calculation-overlay){transition:none}}`;
          doc.head.appendChild(loadingStyle);

          const drawingArea = doc.querySelector(".drawing-area");
          const detailedDrawing = doc.querySelector("#rampDrawing");
          const resultBox = doc.querySelector(".result-box");
          let drawingOverlay = drawingArea?.querySelector(".drawing-calculation-overlay");
          if (drawingArea && detailedDrawing && !drawingOverlay) {
            drawingOverlay = doc.createElement("div");
            drawingOverlay.className = "drawing-calculation-overlay";
            drawingOverlay.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
            const spinner = doc.createElement("span");
            spinner.className = "drawing-calculation-spinner";
            drawingOverlay.appendChild(spinner);
            drawingArea.appendChild(drawingOverlay);
          }
          let resultOverlay = resultBox?.querySelector(".result-calculation-overlay");
          if (resultBox && !resultOverlay) {
            resultOverlay = doc.createElement("div");
            resultOverlay.className = "result-calculation-overlay";
            resultOverlay.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
            const spinner = doc.createElement("span");
            spinner.className = "result-calculation-spinner";
            resultOverlay.appendChild(spinner);
            resultBox.appendChild(resultOverlay);
          }
          const setDrawingLoading = active => {
            if (!drawingArea) return;
            drawingArea.classList.toggle("is-calculating", active);
          };
          const setResultLoading = active => {
            if (!resultBox) return;
            resultBox.classList.toggle("is-calculating", active);
          };

          calculateButton.addEventListener("click", event => {
            if (calculateButton.dataset.calculationLoadingPass === "true") return;
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopImmediatePropagation();
            if (calculateButton.dataset.calculationLoading === "true") return;

            const label = calculateButton.querySelector('[data-i18n="calculate"]') || calculateButton.querySelector("span");
            if (!label) {
              calculateButton.dataset.calculationLoadingPass = "true";
              calculateButton.click();
              delete calculateButton.dataset.calculationLoadingPass;
              return;
            }
            const originalMarkup = label.innerHTML;
            calculateButton.dataset.calculationLoading = "true";
            calculateButton.classList.add("is-calculating");
            calculateButton.setAttribute("aria-busy", "true");
            setDrawingLoading(true);
            setResultLoading(true);
            label.innerHTML = '<span class="calculate-loading-dots" aria-label="در حال محاسبه"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span>';

            window.setTimeout(() => {
              label.innerHTML = originalMarkup;
              calculateButton.classList.remove("is-calculating");
              calculateButton.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
              delete calculateButton.dataset.calculationLoading;
              // The state-sync listener intentionally disables the button after a
              // completed calculation. Re-enable it for this one replayed click
              // so the original source listener can receive the event and update
              // the result and precise drawing.
              calculateButton.disabled = false;
              calculateButton.dataset.calculationLoadingPass = "true";
              calculateButton.click();
              delete calculateButton.dataset.calculationLoadingPass;
              // Let the source render the new SVG first, then reveal it sharply.
              window.setTimeout(() => {
                setDrawingLoading(false);
                setResultLoading(false);
              }, 110);
            }, 700);
          }, true);
          sync(false);
        }

        // Keep a clear unit suffix beside every numeric ramp-width field.
        setTimeout(() => {
            [
            ["#exportJpgWidthUnit", "#exportJpgWidthSuffix"],
            ["#exportPdfWidthUnit", "#exportPdfWidthSuffix"],
            ["#exportDxfWidthUnit", "#exportDxfWidthSuffix"]
          ].forEach(([unitSelector, suffixSelector]) => {
            const unit = doc.querySelector(unitSelector);
            const suffix = doc.querySelector(suffixSelector);
            if (!unit || !suffix) return;
            const sync = () => {
              suffix.textContent = unit.value === "cm" || unit.value === "centimeter" ? "cm" : "m";
            };
            unit.addEventListener("change", sync);
            sync();
          });
        }, 80);

        // The drawing view controls live inside the source iframe. Bind them
        // in capture phase as a stable fallback so the Plan button keeps
        // working even if a later injected UI listener intercepts the click.
        if (!doc.documentElement.dataset.drawingViewControlsReady) {
          doc.documentElement.dataset.drawingViewControlsReady = "true";
          doc.addEventListener("click", event => {
            const button = event.target.closest?.(".view-tab[data-view]");
            if (!button) return;
            const view = button.dataset.view;
            if (view !== "plan" && view !== "section") return;
            const api = frame.contentWindow.rampExportAPI;
            if (typeof api?.setView !== "function") return;
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopImmediatePropagation();
            if (!doc.getElementById("viewSwitchMotionStyle")) {
              const style = doc.createElement("style");
              style.id = "viewSwitchMotionStyle";
              style.textContent = `
                .view-tab.view-switch-animate {
                  animation: rampViewSwitchTap .34s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
                }
                #rampDrawing.view-switch-drawing-animate {
                  animation: rampViewSwitchDrawing .42s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
                }
                @keyframes rampViewSwitchTap {
                  0% { transform: scale(1); }
                  45% { transform: scale(.965); }
                  100% { transform: scale(1); }
                }
                @keyframes rampViewSwitchDrawing {
                  0% { opacity: .28; filter: blur(3px); }
                  55% { opacity: .78; filter: blur(.8px); }
                  100% { opacity: 1; filter: blur(0); }
                }
                @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
                  .view-tab.view-switch-animate,
                  #rampDrawing.view-switch-drawing-animate { animation: none; }
                }
              `;
              doc.head.appendChild(style);
            }
            api.setView(view);
            button.classList.remove("view-switch-animate");
            void button.offsetWidth;
            button.classList.add("view-switch-animate");
            window.setTimeout(() => button.classList.remove("view-switch-animate"), 360);
            const drawing = doc.querySelector("#rampDrawing");
            if (drawing) {
              drawing.classList.remove("view-switch-drawing-animate");
              void drawing.offsetWidth;
              drawing.classList.add("view-switch-drawing-animate");
              window.setTimeout(() => drawing.classList.remove("view-switch-drawing-animate"), 460);
            }
          }, true);
        }

        // Keep the detailed drawing tied to the selected ramp tab. Do not let
        // the previous tab's calculated result remain visible after switching.
        if (!doc.documentElement.dataset.drawingTypeControlsReady) {
          doc.documentElement.dataset.drawingTypeControlsReady = "true";
          doc.addEventListener("click", event => {
            const button = event.target.closest?.(".type-tab[data-type]");
            if (!button) return;
            const type = button.dataset.type;
            if (!["car", "disabled", "human"].includes(type)) return;
            const api = frame.contentWindow.rampExportAPI;
            if (typeof api?.setType !== "function") return;
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopImmediatePropagation();
            api.setType(type);
            syncParkingStopControl();
            const activeInput = doc.querySelector(
              `.form-section[data-form="${type}"] input, .form-section[data-form="${type}"] select`
            );
            activeInput?.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
          }, true);
        }

        // Small scroll affordance for long pages, responsive to viewport height.
        if (!doc.getElementById('pageScrollCue')) {
          const scrollCueStyle = doc.createElement('style');
          scrollCueStyle.id = 'pageScrollCueStyle';
          scrollCueStyle.textContent = `
            #pageScrollCue {
              position: fixed;
              left: 50%;
              bottom: max(13px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
              z-index: 140;
              width: 30px;
              height: 30px;
              display: grid;
              place-items: center;
              border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 82%, var(--text) 18%);
              border-radius: 999px;
              background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-solid) 76%, transparent);
              color: var(--muted);
              box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(8, 15, 35, .14);
              -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(145%);
              backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(145%);
              transform: translateX(-50%);
              opacity: 1;
              pointer-events: auto;
              cursor: pointer;
              transition: opacity .24s ease, transform .24s ease;
            }
            #pageScrollCue svg {
              width: 16px;
              height: 16px;
              animation: pageScrollCueBounce 1.15s ease-in-out infinite;
            }
            #pageScrollCue.is-hidden {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: translate(-50%, 8px);
            }

              0%, 100% { transform: translateY(-2px); }
              50% { transform: translateY(4px); }
            }
            @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
              #pageScrollCue svg { animation: none; }
            }
          `;
          doc.head.appendChild(scrollCueStyle);

          const scrollCue = doc.createElement('div');
          scrollCue.id = 'pageScrollCue';
          scrollCue.setAttribute('role', 'button');
          scrollCue.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
          scrollCue.setAttribute('aria-label', 'رفتن به انتهای صفحه');
          scrollCue.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
          scrollCue.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg>';
          doc.body.appendChild(scrollCue);

          let pageScrollCueDismissed = false;
          const updatePageScrollCue = () => {
            const scrollingElement = doc.scrollingElement || doc.documentElement;
            const viewportHeight = doc.defaultView?.innerHeight || doc.documentElement.clientHeight;
            const hasMoreContent = scrollingElement.scrollHeight > viewportHeight + 24;
            const atBottom = scrollingElement.scrollTop + viewportHeight >= scrollingElement.scrollHeight - 24;
            const modalOpen = Boolean(doc.querySelector('#exportModal.open, .modal.open'));
            if (scrollingElement.scrollTop > 18) pageScrollCueDismissed = true;
            scrollCue.classList.toggle('is-hidden', pageScrollCueDismissed || !hasMoreContent || atBottom || modalOpen);
          };
          doc.addEventListener('scroll', updatePageScrollCue, { passive: true });
          doc.defaultView?.addEventListener('resize', updatePageScrollCue);
          new MutationObserver(updatePageScrollCue).observe(doc.body, { subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
          const scrollToPageEnd = () => {
            pageScrollCueDismissed = true;
            scrollCue.classList.add('is-hidden');
            const scrollingElement = doc.scrollingElement || doc.documentElement;
            scrollingElement.scrollTo({ top: scrollingElement.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' });
          };
          scrollCue.addEventListener('click', scrollToPageEnd);
          scrollCue.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
            if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
              event.preventDefault();
              scrollToPageEnd();
            }
          });
          updatePageScrollCue();
          requestAnimationFrame(updatePageScrollCue);
        }

        // Build unified Export UI once.
        if (!doc.getElementById("exportBtn")) {
          const pdfBtn = doc.getElementById("pdfBtn");

          const miniActions = pdfBtn?.closest(".mini-actions") || dxfBtn?.closest(".mini-actions");

          if (pdfBtn && dxfBtn && miniActions) {
            pdfBtn.style.display = "none";
            dxfBtn.style.display = "none";

            const exportBtn = doc.createElement("button");
            exportBtn.className = "small-btn";
            exportBtn.id = "exportBtn";
            exportBtn.type = "button";
            exportBtn.setAttribute("aria-haspopup", "dialog");
            exportBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
            exportBtn.innerHTML = `
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">
                <path d="M12 3v11"/><path d="m7.5 10.5 4.5 4.5 4.5-4.5"/><path d="M4 20h16"/>
              </svg>
              <span>Export</span>`;
            miniActions.insertBefore(exportBtn, pdfBtn);

            const modal = doc.createElement("div");
            modal.className = "export-modal-backdrop";
            modal.id = "exportModal";
            modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
            modal.innerHTML = `
              <section class="export-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="exportModalTitle">
                <div class="export-modal-head">
                  <div class="export-modal-title" id="exportModalTitle">خروجی فایل</div>
                  <button class="export-close-btn" id="exportCloseBtn" type="button" aria-label="بستن">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6 6 18"/></svg>
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div class="export-modal-body">
                  <div class="export-format-switch" role="tablist" aria-label="Export format">
                    <button class="export-format-btn active" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="true" data-export-format="pdf">PDF</button>
                    <button class="export-format-btn" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="false" data-export-format="dxf">DXF</button>
                  </div>

                  <div class="export-settings-panel active" data-export-panel="pdf">
                    <div class="export-setting-row">
                      <div class="export-setting-copy">
                        <div class="export-setting-label" data-export-i18n="pdfPagesLabel">محتوای خروجی</div>
                        <div class="export-setting-hint" data-export-i18n="pdfPagesHint">انتخاب ترسیم مورد نظر برای خروجی</div>
                      </div>
                      <select class="export-select" id="exportPdfPages">
                        <option value="plan">پلان</option>
                        <option value="section">نما</option>
                        <option value="both">پلان + نما</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    <div class="export-setting-row" id="exportPdfWidthRow">
                      <div class="export-setting-copy">
                        <div class="export-setting-label" data-export-i18n="pdfWidthLabel">عرض رمپ در پلان</div>
                        <div class="export-setting-hint" data-export-i18n="pdfWidthHint">واحد عرض را انتخاب کنید؛ فقط در پلان یا پلان + نما</div>
                      </div>
                      <div class="export-number-with-suffix"><input class="export-select" id="exportPdfWidth" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" value="3.5" inputmode="decimal"><span class="export-width-unit-suffix" id="exportPdfWidthSuffix">m</span></div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="export-setting-row" id="exportPdfWidthUnitRow">
                      <div class="export-setting-copy">
                        <div class="export-setting-label" data-export-i18n="widthUnitLabel">واحد اندازه‌ها</div>
                        <div class="export-setting-hint" data-export-i18n="widthUnitHint">واحد نمایش اندازه‌های خروجی</div>
                      </div>
                      <select class="export-select" id="exportPdfWidthUnit" aria-label="واحد اندازه‌ها">
                        <option value="m" selected>متر (m)</option>
                        <option value="cm">سانتی‌متر (cm)</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    <div class="export-setting-row">
                      <div class="export-setting-copy">
                        <div class="export-setting-label" data-export-i18n="pdfQualityLabel">کیفیت</div>
                        <div class="export-setting-hint" data-export-i18n="pdfQualityHint">رزولوشن خروجی فنی</div>
                      </div>
                      <select class="export-select" id="exportPdfQuality">
                        <option value="minimum">Minimum (72 DPI · کمترین حجم)</option>
                        <option value="low">Low (96 DPI · فایل سبک)</option>
                        <option value="medium">Medium (144 DPI · استفاده عمومی)</option>
                        <option value="high" selected>High (240 DPI · چاپ باکیفیت)</option>
                        <option value="maximum">Maximum (300 DPI · حداکثر جزئیات)</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div class="export-settings-panel" data-export-panel="dxf">
                    <div class="export-setting-row">
                      <div class="export-setting-copy">
                        <div class="export-setting-label" data-export-i18n="dxfViewLabel">محتوای خروجی</div>
                        <div class="export-setting-hint" data-export-i18n="dxfViewHint">انتخاب ترسیم مورد نظر برای خروجی</div>
                      </div>
                      <select class="export-select" id="exportDxfView">
                        <option value="plan">پلان</option>
                        <option value="section">نما</option>
                        <option value="both">پلان + نما</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    <div class="export-setting-row">
                      <div class="export-setting-copy">
                        <div class="export-setting-label" data-export-i18n="dxfUnitLabel">واحد</div>
                        <div class="export-setting-hint" data-export-i18n="dxfUnitHint">واحد هندسه در فایل DXF</div>
                      </div>
