                        <div class="export-setting-hint" data-export-i18n="dxfWidthHint">مقدار عرض رمپ و واحد آن را انتخاب کنید</div>
                      </div>
                      <div class="export-number-with-suffix"><input class="export-select" id="exportDxfWidth" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" value="3.5" inputmode="decimal"><span class="export-width-unit-suffix" id="exportDxfWidthSuffix">m</span></div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="export-setting-row" id="exportDxfWidthUnitRow">
                      <div class="export-setting-copy">
                        <div class="export-setting-label" data-export-i18n="widthUnitLabel">واحد اندازه‌ها</div>
                        <div class="export-setting-hint" data-export-i18n="widthUnitHint">واحد نمایش اندازه‌های خروجی</div>
                      </div>
                      <select class="export-select" id="exportDxfWidthUnit" aria-label="واحد اندازه‌ها">
                        <option value="m" selected>متر (m)</option>
                        <option value="cm">سانتی‌متر (cm)</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>

                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="export-modal-footer">
                  <button id="exportDownloadBtn" type="button">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3v11"/><path d="m7.5 10.5 4.5 4.5 4.5-4.5"/><path d="M4 20h16"/></svg>
                    <span id="exportDownloadLabel">دانلود PDF</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </section>`;
            const exportPanel = modal.querySelector(".export-modal");
            if (exportPanel && !exportPanel.querySelector(":scope > .glass-content")) {
              const exportNodes = [...exportPanel.childNodes];
              const glassFilter = doc.createElement("div");
              glassFilter.className = "glass-filter";
              glassFilter.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
              const glassOverlay = doc.createElement("div");
              glassOverlay.className = "glass-overlay";
              glassOverlay.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
              const glassSpecular = doc.createElement("div");
              glassSpecular.className = "glass-specular";
              glassSpecular.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
              const glassContent = doc.createElement("div");
              glassContent.className = "glass-content";
              exportNodes.forEach(node => glassContent.appendChild(node));
              exportPanel.append(glassFilter, glassOverlay, glassSpecular, glassContent);
            }
            doc.body.appendChild(modal);

            // Interactive edge highlight for Export controls only. The modal itself
            // remains static; the light follows the pointer inside each box.
            modal.querySelectorAll('.export-setting-row, .export-format-picker, .export-check-control, .export-choice-control, .export-meta-chip, .export-select').forEach(control => {
              control.addEventListener('pointermove', event => {
                const rect = control.getBoundingClientRect();
                control.style.setProperty('--mx', `${event.clientX - rect.left}px`);
                control.style.setProperty('--my', `${event.clientY - rect.top}px`);
              });
            });
            // Delegation also covers the Format picker and panels injected after
            // the modal is created by the Export enhancement layer.
            modal.addEventListener('pointermove', event => {
              const control = event.target.closest?.('.export-setting-row, .export-format-picker, .export-check-control, .export-choice-control, .export-meta-chip, .export-select');
              if (!control || !modal.contains(control)) return;
              const rect = control.getBoundingClientRect();
              control.style.setProperty('--mx', `${event.clientX - rect.left}px`);
              control.style.setProperty('--my', `${event.clientY - rect.top}px`);
            });

            const closeBtn = modal.querySelector("#exportCloseBtn");
            const downloadBtn = modal.querySelector("#exportDownloadBtn");
            const downloadLabel = modal.querySelector("#exportDownloadLabel");
            const formatButtons = [...modal.querySelectorAll("[data-export-format]")];
            const panels = [...modal.querySelectorAll("[data-export-panel]")];
            const pdfPages = modal.querySelector("#exportPdfPages");
            const pdfWidth = modal.querySelector("#exportPdfWidth");
            const pdfWidthUnit = modal.querySelector("#exportPdfWidthUnit");
            const pdfWidthRow = modal.querySelector("#exportPdfWidthRow");
            const pdfQuality = modal.querySelector("#exportPdfQuality");
            const dxfView = modal.querySelector("#exportDxfView");
            const dxfUnit = modal.querySelector("#exportDxfUnit");
            const dxfWidth = modal.querySelector("#exportDxfWidth");
            const dxfWidthRow = modal.querySelector("#exportDxfWidth")?.closest(".export-setting-row");
            const dxfWidthUnit = modal.querySelector("#exportDxfWidthUnit");
            let activeFormat = "pdf";
            try {
              const api = frame.contentWindow.rampExportAPI;
              const geometry = api?.geometry?.();
              const fallbackWidth = api?.type?.() === "car" ? 3.5 : 1.2;
              const widthM = Number(geometry?.widthM) || fallbackWidth;
              if (dxfWidth) dxfWidth.value = Number(widthM.toFixed(3));
              if (pdfWidth) pdfWidth.value = Number(widthM.toFixed(3));
              if (dxfWidthUnit) dxfWidthUnit.value = "m";
              if (pdfWidthUnit) pdfWidthUnit.value = "m";
            } catch (_) { /* keep the safe default */ }

            const syncPdfWidthVisibility = () => {
              const includesPlan = pdfPages.value === "plan" || pdfPages.value === "both";
              pdfWidthRow?.classList.toggle("is-muted", !includesPlan);
              if (pdfWidth) pdfWidth.disabled = !includesPlan;
            };
            pdfPages.addEventListener("change", syncPdfWidthVisibility);
            let pdfWidthPreviousUnit = pdfWidthUnit?.value || "m";
            pdfWidthUnit?.addEventListener("change", () => {
              const numericWidth = Number(pdfWidth?.value);
              if (!Number.isFinite(numericWidth) || numericWidth <= 0) {
                pdfWidthPreviousUnit = pdfWidthUnit.value;
                return;
              }
              const widthM = pdfWidthPreviousUnit === "cm" ? numericWidth / 100 : numericWidth;
              pdfWidth.value = pdfWidthUnit.value === "cm"
                ? Number((widthM * 100).toFixed(2))
                : Number(widthM.toFixed(3));
              pdfWidthPreviousUnit = pdfWidthUnit.value;
            });

            const textFA = {
              title: "خروجی فایل",
              close: "بستن",
              pdfPagesLabel: "محتوای خروجی",
              pdfPagesHint: "انتخاب ترسیم مورد نظر برای خروجی",
              pdfWidthLabel: "عرض رمپ در پلان",
              pdfWidthHint: "واحد عرض را انتخاب کنید؛ فقط در پلان یا پلان + نما",
              widthUnitLabel: "واحد اندازه‌ها",
              widthUnitHint: "واحد نمایش اندازه‌های خروجی",
              pdfQualityLabel: "کیفیت",
              pdfQualityHint: "رزولوشن خروجی فنی",
              dxfViewLabel: "محتوای خروجی",
              dxfViewHint: "انتخاب ترسیم مورد نظر برای خروجی",
              dxfUnitLabel: "واحد",
              dxfUnitHint: "واحد هندسه در فایل DXF",
              dxfWidthLabel: "عرض رمپ",
              dxfWidthHint: "مقدار عرض رمپ و واحد آن را انتخاب کنید",
              landscape: "افقی",
              technicalSheet: "نقشه فنی",
              vectorGeometry: "هندسه برداری",
              downloadPdf: "دانلود PDF",
              downloadDxf: "دانلود DXF"
            };
            const textEN = {
              title: "Export File",
              close: "Close",
              pdfPagesLabel: "Output content",
              pdfPagesHint: "Choose the drawings to include in the output",
              pdfWidthLabel: "Ramp width in plan",
              pdfWidthHint: "Choose the width unit; used for Plan or Plan + Section",
              widthUnitLabel: "Measurement unit",
              widthUnitHint: "Unit used to display output dimensions",
              pdfQualityLabel: "Quality",
              pdfQualityHint: "Technical export resolution",
              dxfViewLabel: "Output content",
              dxfViewHint: "Choose the drawings to include in the output",
              dxfUnitLabel: "Unit",
              dxfUnitHint: "Geometry unit in the DXF file",
              dxfWidthLabel: "Ramp width",
              dxfWidthHint: "Choose the ramp width and its unit",
              landscape: "Landscape",
              technicalSheet: "Technical Sheet",
              vectorGeometry: "Vector Geometry",
              downloadPdf: "Download PDF",
              downloadDxf: "Download DXF"
            };

            const updateExportLanguage = () => {
              const en = doc.documentElement.dataset.lang === "en";
              const tx = en ? textEN : textFA;
              modal.querySelector("#exportModalTitle").textContent = tx.title;
              closeBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", tx.close);
              modal.querySelectorAll("[data-export-i18n]").forEach(el => {
                const key = el.dataset.exportI18n;
                if (tx[key]) el.textContent = tx[key];
              });

              const pageOptions = [...pdfPages.options];
              pageOptions[0].textContent = en ? "Plan" : "پلان";
              pageOptions[1].textContent = en ? "Section" : "نما";
              pageOptions[2].textContent = en ? "Plan + Section" : "پلان + نما";
              syncPdfWidthVisibility();
              pdfQuality.options[0].textContent = en ? "Minimum (smallest file · 72 DPI)" : "Minimum (72 DPI · کمترین حجم)";
              pdfQuality.options[1].textContent = en ? "Low (lightweight · 96 DPI)" : "Low (96 DPI · فایل سبک)";
              pdfQuality.options[2].textContent = en ? "Medium (general use · 144 DPI)" : "Medium (144 DPI · استفاده عمومی)";
              pdfQuality.options[3].textContent = en ? "High (quality print · 240 DPI)" : "High (240 DPI · چاپ باکیفیت)";
              pdfQuality.options[4].textContent = en ? "Maximum (maximum detail · 300 DPI)" : "Maximum (300 DPI · حداکثر جزئیات)";
              dxfView.options[0].textContent = en ? "Plan" : "پلان";
              dxfView.options[1].textContent = en ? "Section" : "نما";
              dxfView.options[2].textContent = en ? "Plan + Section" : "پلان + نما";
              dxfUnit.options[0].textContent = en ? "Meter (m)" : "متر (m)";
              dxfUnit.options[1].textContent = en ? "Centimeter (cm)" : "سانتی‌متر (cm)";
              if (pdfWidthUnit) {
                pdfWidthUnit.options[0].textContent = en ? "Meter (m)" : "متر (m)";
                pdfWidthUnit.options[1].textContent = en ? "Centimeter (cm)" : "سانتی‌متر (cm)";
              }
              if (dxfWidthUnit) {
                dxfWidthUnit.options[0].textContent = en ? "Meter (m)" : "متر (m)";
                dxfWidthUnit.options[1].textContent = en ? "Centimeter (cm)" : "سانتی‌متر (cm)";
              }
              downloadLabel.textContent = activeFormat === "pdf" ? tx.downloadPdf : tx.downloadDxf;
            };

            const setFormat = format => {
              activeFormat = format === "dxf" ? "dxf" : "pdf";
              formatButtons.forEach(btn => {
                const active = btn.dataset.exportFormat === activeFormat;
                btn.classList.toggle("active", active);
                btn.setAttribute("aria-selected", active ? "true" : "false");
              });
              panels.forEach(panel => panel.classList.toggle("active", panel.dataset.exportPanel === activeFormat));
              if (activeFormat === "pdf") syncPdfWidthVisibility();
              updateExportLanguage();
            };

            const syncDxfDefaults = () => {
              const activeView = doc.querySelector(".view-tab.active")?.dataset.view;
              if (activeView === "plan" || activeView === "section") dxfView.value = activeView;

              const visibleUnitSelect = [...doc.querySelectorAll(".height-unit-select")]
                .find(el => el.offsetParent !== null) || doc.querySelector(".height-unit-select");
              if (visibleUnitSelect && (visibleUnitSelect.value === "m" || visibleUnitSelect.value === "cm")) {
                const nextUnit = visibleUnitSelect.value;
                dxfUnit.value = nextUnit;
                dxfPreviousUnit = nextUnit;
              }
              const includesPlan = dxfView.value === "plan" || dxfView.value === "both";
              dxfWidthRow?.classList.toggle("is-muted", !includesPlan);
              if (dxfWidth) dxfWidth.disabled = !includesPlan;
            };
            const syncDxfWidthVisibility = () => {
              const includesPlan = dxfView.value === "plan" || dxfView.value === "both";
              dxfWidthRow?.classList.toggle("is-muted", !includesPlan);
              if (dxfWidth) dxfWidth.disabled = !includesPlan;
            };
            dxfView.addEventListener("change", syncDxfWidthVisibility);
            let dxfPreviousUnit = dxfUnit.value;
            let dxfWidthPreviousUnit = dxfWidthUnit?.value || "m";
            dxfWidthUnit?.addEventListener("change", () => {
              const numericWidth = Number(dxfWidth?.value);
              if (!Number.isFinite(numericWidth) || numericWidth <= 0) {
                dxfWidthPreviousUnit = dxfWidthUnit.value;
                return;
              }
              const widthM = dxfWidthPreviousUnit === "cm" ? numericWidth / 100 : numericWidth;
              dxfWidth.value = dxfWidthUnit.value === "cm"
                ? Number((widthM * 100).toFixed(2))
                : Number(widthM.toFixed(3));
              dxfWidthPreviousUnit = dxfWidthUnit.value;
            });
            dxfUnit.addEventListener("change", () => {
              dxfPreviousUnit = dxfUnit.value;
            });

            const openExport = () => {
              syncDxfDefaults();
              modal.classList.add("open");
              modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
              exportBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
              requestAnimationFrame(() => closeBtn.focus({ preventScroll: true }));
            };
            const closeExport = () => {
              modal.classList.remove("open");
              modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
              exportBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
              exportBtn.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            };

            exportBtn.addEventListener("click", openExport);
            closeBtn.addEventListener("click", closeExport);
            modal.addEventListener("click", event => { if (event.target === modal) closeExport(); });
            formatButtons.forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener("click", () => setFormat(btn.dataset.exportFormat)));

            downloadBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
              if (downloadBtn.disabled) return;
              if (activeFormat === "pdf") pdfBtn.click();
              else dxfBtn.click();
            });

            doc.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
              if (event.key === "Escape" && modal.classList.contains("open")) closeExport();
            });

            const langObserver = new MutationObserver(updateExportLanguage);
            langObserver.observe(doc.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["data-lang"] });
            setFormat("pdf");
          }
        }
        if (!doc.querySelector("#versionPopover")) throw new Error("پنجره نسخه ساخته نشد.");
        if (!doc.querySelector("#downloadPopover")) throw new Error("منوی دانلود ساخته نشد.");
        if (!doc.querySelector('#carTransition') || doc.querySelectorAll('#carTransition option').length !== 2) throw new Error("گزینه‌های شیب ابتدا و انتها ساخته نشد.");
        if (!doc.querySelector("#carAfterRamp3m")) throw new Error("گزینه ۳ متر بعد از رمپ ساخته نشد.");
        if (!doc.documentElement.dataset.historyUiReady) {
          doc.documentElement.dataset.historyUiReady = "true";
          const historyFields = ["#carHeight", "#carSlope", "#carTransition", "#carAfterRamp3m", "#disabledHeight", "#disabledSlope", "#disabledRegulations", "#disabledCompanion", "#humanHeight", "#humanSlope"];
          const captureHistoryState = () => ({
            type: doc.querySelector(".type-tab.active")?.dataset.type || "car",
            view: doc.querySelector(".view-tab.active")?.dataset.view || "section",
            units: Object.fromEntries([...doc.querySelectorAll(".height-unit-select")].map(el => [el.id, el.value])),
            values: Object.fromEntries(historyFields.map(selector => {
              const el = doc.querySelector(selector);
              return [selector, el ? (el.type === "checkbox" ? el.checked : el.value) : null];
            }))
          });
          const historyEqual = (a, b) => JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);
          const history = [captureHistoryState()];
          let historyIndex = 0;
          const undo = doc.querySelector("#undoCalculationBtn");
          const redo = doc.querySelector("#redoCalculationBtn");
          const historyButton = doc.querySelector("#openCalculationHistoryBtn");
          const historyPopover = doc.querySelector("#calculationHistoryPopover");
          const historyList = doc.querySelector("#calculationHistoryList");
          const closeHistoryButton = doc.querySelector("#closeCalculationHistoryBtn");
          const calculate = doc.querySelector("#calculateBtn");
          const syncHistoryButtons = () => {
            if (undo) undo.disabled = historyIndex <= 0;
            if (redo) redo.disabled = historyIndex >= history.length - 1;
          };
          const historyTypeLabels = { car: "خودرو", disabled: "معلول", human: "عمومی" };
          const historyDetail = snapshot => {
            const fields = snapshot.type === "disabled"
              ? ["#disabledHeight", "#disabledSlope"]
              : snapshot.type === "human"
                ? ["#humanHeight", "#humanSlope"]
                : ["#carHeight", "#carSlope"];
            const values = fields.map(selector => snapshot.values?.[selector]).filter(value => value !== null && value !== undefined && value !== "");
            const unit = Object.values(snapshot.units || {}).find(value => value === "m" || value === "cm") || "";
            const height = values[0] ? `ارتفاع ${values[0]}${unit ? ` ${unit}` : ""}` : "";
            const slope = values[1] ? `شیب ${values[1]}%` : "";
            return [historyTypeLabels[snapshot.type] || snapshot.type, height, slope].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
          };
          const renderHistoryList = () => {
            if (!historyList) return;
            historyList.replaceChildren();
            const start = Math.max(0, history.length - 10);
            const recent = history.slice(start).reverse();
            if (!recent.length) {
              const empty = doc.createElement("div");
              empty.className = "history-popover-empty";
              empty.textContent = "هنوز محاسبه‌ای ثبت نشده است.";
              historyList.appendChild(empty);
              return;
            }
            recent.forEach((snapshot, offset) => {
              const absoluteIndex = history.length - 1 - offset;
              const item = doc.createElement("button");
              item.type = "button";
              item.className = "history-popover-item" + (absoluteIndex === historyIndex ? " is-current" : "");
              item.setAttribute("aria-label", absoluteIndex === 0 ? "وضعیت اولیه" : `محاسبه ${absoluteIndex}`);

              const main = doc.createElement("span");
              main.className = "history-popover-item-main";
              const title = doc.createElement("span");
              title.className = "history-popover-item-title";
              title.textContent = absoluteIndex === 0 ? "وضعیت اولیه" : `محاسبه ${absoluteIndex}`;
              const detail = doc.createElement("span");
              detail.className = "history-popover-item-detail";
              detail.textContent = historyDetail(snapshot);
              main.append(title, detail);

              const index = doc.createElement("span");
              index.className = "history-popover-item-index";
              index.textContent = absoluteIndex === history.length - 1 ? "آخرین" : `#${absoluteIndex}`;
              item.append(main, index);
              item.addEventListener("click", () => {
                historyIndex = absoluteIndex;
                applyHistoryState(history[historyIndex]);
                closeHistory();
              });
              historyList.appendChild(item);
            });
          };
          const closeHistory = () => {
            historyPopover?.classList.remove("open");
            historyPopover?.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
            historyButton?.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
          };
          const openHistory = () => {
            renderHistoryList();
            historyPopover?.classList.add("open");
            historyPopover?.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
            historyButton?.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
          };
          const applyHistoryState = snapshot => {
            if (!snapshot) return;
            doc.querySelector(`.type-tab[data-type="${snapshot.type}"]`)?.click();
            Object.entries(snapshot.units || {}).forEach(([id, value]) => {
              const el = doc.getElementById(id);
              if (el && el.value !== value) {
                el.value = value;
                el.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
              }
            });
            historyFields.forEach(selector => {
              const el = doc.querySelector(selector);
              const value = snapshot.values?.[selector];
              if (!el || value === null || value === undefined) return;
              if (el.type === "checkbox") el.checked = Boolean(value);
              else el.value = value;
            });
            doc.querySelector(`.view-tab[data-view="${snapshot.view}"]`)?.click();
            frame.contentWindow.rampExportAPI?.refresh();
            syncHistoryButtons();
            renderHistoryList();
          };
          calculate?.addEventListener("click", () => {
            const next = captureHistoryState();
            if (!historyEqual(history[historyIndex], next)) {
              history.splice(historyIndex + 1);
              history.push(next);
              historyIndex = history.length - 1;
            }
            syncHistoryButtons();
            renderHistoryList();
          });
          undo?.addEventListener("click", event => {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopImmediatePropagation();
            if (historyIndex <= 0) return;
            historyIndex -= 1;
            applyHistoryState(history[historyIndex]);
          }, true);
          redo?.addEventListener("click", event => {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopImmediatePropagation();
            if (historyIndex >= history.length - 1) return;
            historyIndex += 1;
            applyHistoryState(history[historyIndex]);
          }, true);
          historyButton?.addEventListener("click", event => {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
            if (historyPopover?.classList.contains("open")) closeHistory();
            else openHistory();
          });
          closeHistoryButton?.addEventListener("click", event => {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
            closeHistory();
            historyButton?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
          });
          doc.addEventListener("click", event => {
            if (!historyPopover?.classList.contains("open")) return;
            if (historyPopover.contains(event.target) || event.target === historyButton) return;
            closeHistory();
          });
          syncHistoryButtons();
          renderHistoryList();
        }
        if (!frame.contentWindow.renderTechnicalSheetToJpeg && !frame.contentWindow.buildA4Pdf) { /* functions are scoped inside the app IIFE */ }

        if (!doc.getElementById("rampHeaderIconStyle")) {
          const iconStyle = doc.createElement("style");
          iconStyle.id = "rampHeaderIconStyle";
          iconStyle.textContent = `
            #rampHeaderIcon {
              width: 100%;
              height: 100%;
              display: block;
              object-fit: contain;
              border-radius: 12px;
            }
            .ramp-header-icon-host {
              overflow: hidden;
              background: transparent !important;
              box-shadow: none !important;
              padding: 0 !important;
            }
          `;
          doc.head.appendChild(iconStyle);
        }

        const titleEl = doc.querySelector('[data-i18n="appTitle"]')
          || [...doc.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,div,span')].find(el => /ابزار\s*محاسبه\s*رمپ|Ramp\s*Calculation/i.test((el.textContent || '').trim()));

        if (titleEl) {
          const textBlock = titleEl.parentElement;
          const host = titleEl.closest('.brand')
            || titleEl.closest('.app-brand')
            || (textBlock && textBlock.parentElement ? textBlock.parentElement : titleEl.parentElement);

          const brandIconHost = host
            ? [...host.children].find(el => el !== textBlock && !(textBlock && el.contains(textBlock)))
            : null;

          if (brandIconHost) {
            brandIconHost.classList.add('ramp-header-icon-host');
            brandIconHost.innerHTML = '';

            const img = doc.createElement('img');
            img.id = 'rampHeaderIcon';
            img.alt = 'Ramp icon';
            img.src = "data:image/png;base64,";
            brandIconHost.appendChild(img);
          }
        }


        // Snipzy Liquid Glass Card structure for the main Rules rectangles only.
        // Do not glassify nested headings; that caused the previous visual artifacts.
        const rulesCards = [
          ...doc.querySelectorAll(".modal.rules-glass .rule-card"),
          ...doc.querySelectorAll(".modal.rules-glass .rules-document-content")
        ].filter((el, index, arr) =>
          arr.indexOf(el) === index &&
          !el.closest(".snipzy-glass-card")
        );

        rulesCards.forEach(card => {
          if (card.classList.contains("snipzy-glass-card")) return;

          card.classList.add("snipzy-glass-card");

          // Move all original card content into a dedicated Snipzy glass-content layer.
          const originalChildren = [...card.childNodes];

          const glassFilter = doc.createElement("div");
          glassFilter.className = "glass-filter";
          glassFilter.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");

          const distortionOverlay = doc.createElement("div");
          distortionOverlay.className = "glass-distortion-overlay";
          distortionOverlay.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");

          const glassOverlay = doc.createElement("div");
          glassOverlay.className = "glass-overlay";
          glassOverlay.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");

          const glassSpecular = doc.createElement("div");
          glassSpecular.className = "glass-specular";
          glassSpecular.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");

          const glassContent = doc.createElement("div");
          glassContent.className = "glass-content";
          originalChildren.forEach(node => glassContent.appendChild(node));

          card.append(
            glassFilter,
            distortionOverlay,
            glassOverlay,
            glassSpecular,
            glassContent
          );

          // Snipzy mouse highlight effect.
          card.addEventListener("mousemove", function(e) {
            const rect = this.getBoundingClientRect();
            const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
            const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

            const specular = this.querySelector(":scope > .glass-specular");
            if (specular) {
              specular.style.background = `radial-gradient(
                circle at ${x}px ${y}px,
                rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 0%,
                rgba(255,255,255,0.05) 30%,
                rgba(255,255,255,0) 60%
              )`;
            }
          });

          card.addEventListener("mouseleave", function() {
            const specular = this.querySelector(":scope > .glass-specular");
            if (specular) specular.style.background = "none";
          });
        });


        // Download and Version use the exact same static glass layers as Export.
        [doc.querySelector("#downloadPopover"), doc.querySelector("#versionPopover")]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .forEach(card => {
            if (card.classList.contains("export-glass-popover")) return;

            const originalNodes = [...card.childNodes];

            const glassFilter = doc.createElement("div");
            glassFilter.className = "glass-filter";
            glassFilter.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");

            const glassOverlay = doc.createElement("div");
            glassOverlay.className = "glass-overlay";
            glassOverlay.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");

            const glassSpecular = doc.createElement("div");
            glassSpecular.className = "glass-specular";
            glassSpecular.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");

            const glassContent = doc.createElement("div");
            glassContent.className = "glass-content";
            originalNodes.forEach(node => glassContent.appendChild(node));

            card.classList.add("export-glass-popover");
            card.append(glassFilter, glassOverlay, glassSpecular, glassContent);
          });


        // Clean rebuild of the Rules popup only.
        function unwrapRulesGlass(el) {
          if (!el) return;

          const directContent = el.querySelector(':scope > .glass-content');
          if (directContent) {
            const nodes = [...directContent.childNodes];
            directContent.remove();
            nodes.forEach(node => el.appendChild(node));
          }

          el.querySelectorAll(':scope > .glass-filter, :scope > .glass-overlay, :scope > .glass-specular, :scope > .glass-distortion-overlay')
            .forEach(layer => layer.remove());

          el.classList.remove(
            'rules-glass',
            'rules-snipzy-glass',
            'snipzy-glass-card',
            'rules-clean-glass',
            'rules-clean-glass-panel'
          );
        }

        function applyRulesGlass(el, className) {
          if (!el) return;

          unwrapRulesGlass(el);

          const nodes = [...el.childNodes];

          const glassFilter = doc.createElement('div');
          glassFilter.className = 'glass-filter';
          glassFilter.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

          const glassOverlay = doc.createElement('div');
          glassOverlay.className = 'glass-overlay';
          glassOverlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

          const glassSpecular = doc.createElement('div');
          glassSpecular.className = 'glass-specular';
          glassSpecular.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

          const glassContent = doc.createElement('div');
          glassContent.className = 'glass-content';
          nodes.forEach(node => glassContent.appendChild(node));

          el.classList.add(className);
          el.append(glassFilter, glassOverlay, glassSpecular, glassContent);
        }

        const rulesModal = doc.querySelector('.modal');
        const rulesBackdrop = rulesModal?.closest('.modal-backdrop');
        if (rulesBackdrop && rulesModal && !rulesBackdrop.querySelector('.rules-backdrop-blur-strip')) {
          rulesBackdrop.classList.add('rules-backdrop-split-blur');
          ['top','right','bottom','left'].forEach(side => {
            const strip = doc.createElement('div');
            strip.className = 'rules-backdrop-blur-strip rules-backdrop-blur-' + side;
            strip.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
            rulesBackdrop.appendChild(strip);
          });
          const positionBackdropBlur = () => {
            const b = rulesBackdrop.getBoundingClientRect();
            const m = rulesModal.getBoundingClientRect();
            const x = Math.max(0, m.left - b.left), y = Math.max(0, m.top - b.top);
            const r = Math.max(0, b.right - m.right), bot = Math.max(0, b.bottom - m.bottom);
            const set = (side, styles) => Object.assign(rulesBackdrop.querySelector('.rules-backdrop-blur-' + side).style, styles);
            set('top',{left:'0px',top:'0px',right:'0px',height:y+'px'});
            set('right',{left:(b.width-r)+'px',top:y+'px',right:'0px',height:m.height+'px'});
            set('bottom',{left:'0px',top:(b.height-bot)+'px',right:'0px',height:bot+'px'});
            set('left',{left:'0px',top:y+'px',right:(b.width-x)+'px',height:m.height+'px'});
          };
          positionBackdropBlur();
          doc.defaultView.addEventListener('resize', positionBackdropBlur);
        }
        if (rulesModal) {
          applyRulesGlass(rulesModal, 'rules-clean-glass');

          const rulesPanels = rulesModal.querySelectorAll('.rule-card, .rules-document-content');
          rulesPanels.forEach(panel => applyRulesGlass(panel, 'rules-clean-glass-panel'));
          rulesModal.querySelectorAll('.rules-source-card, .source-figure, .source-image-table').forEach(card => {

              card.style.setProperty('--my', (event.clientY - rect.top) + 'px');
            });
          });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
      }
    }, { once: true });

    // Main Rules shell glass (inner text/image panel intentionally untouched).
    source = source.replace("</style>", `
      .modal.rules-glass, .modal.rules-clean-glass {

        filter: none !important;
      }
      .modal.rules-clean-glass .rules-clean-glass-panel > .glass-overlay {

      }

      .modal.rules-clean-glass .rules-clean-glass-panel {

      .modal.rules-clean-glass .rules-source-card,

      /* Frosted treatment for content-bearing cards only. */
      .modal.rules-clean-glass .rules-source-card,

      .modal.rules-clean-glass .rules-source-card::before,
      .modal.rules-clean-glass .source-figure::before,
      .modal.rules-clean-glass .source-image-table::before {

        -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
        -webkit-mask-composite: xor;

      .modal.rules-clean-glass .rules-source-card:hover::before,

      [data-theme="dark"] .modal.rules-clean-glass .rules-source-card::after,

      }
      [data-theme="dark"] .modal.rules-clean-glass .rules-source-card::before,

      }

      .modal-backdrop.rules-backdrop-split-blur > .modal { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    ` + "</style>");

    // Update the Version popover follow text in both the initial markup and
    // the language-refresh handler.
    source = source.replaceAll(
      "برای دریافت آخرین نسخه و به‌روزرسانی‌های این ابزار، پیج Pixel Studio را دنبال کنید.",
      "برای باخبر شدن از آخرین آپدیت‌ نرم افزار و پروژه‌های جدید نرم‌افزاری، پیج Pixel Studio رو فالو کنید."
    );

    // Embed the supplied COPY0856 font and apply it only to the Pixel Studio credit name.
    const pixelStudioFontWoffData = "data:font/woff;base64,";
    const pixelStudioFontData = "data:font/ttf;base64,";
    source = source.replaceAll(
      '<strong>Pixel Studio</strong>',
      '<strong class="pixel-studio-credit-name">Pixel Studio</strong>'

    source = source.replace(
      "</head>",
      `<style id="pixel-studio-credit-font">

          font-size: 8px !important;
          font-synthesis: none !important;
        }

    );

          font-weight: 300 !important;

    );

    // Keep the toast fixed to the viewport so opening an error state or

    source = source.replace(

    );

    );

    // Load the supplied font directly in the iframe document as well. This
    // makes the custom typeface reliable even when a browser delays @font-face
    // evaluation inside srcdoc.
    frame.addEventListener("load", () => {
      const credit = frame.contentDocument?.querySelector(
        ".footer-credit strong.pixel-studio-credit-name"
      );
      if (!credit) return;
      const installPixelStudioFont = async () => {
        try {
          const font = new FontFace(
            "PixelStudioCredit",
            `url("${pixelStudioFontWoffData}") format("woff")`
          );
          const loadedFont = await font.load();
          frame.contentDocument.fonts.add(loadedFont);
          credit.style.setProperty("font-family", "PixelStudioCredit", "important");
          credit.style.setProperty("font-weight", "400", "important");
          credit.style.setProperty("font-synthesis", "none", "important");
        } catch (fontError) {
          console.warn("Pixel Studio font could not be loaded", fontError);
        }
      };
      installPixelStudioFont();
    }, { once: true });

    // Text actions for the Regulations dialog: selecting any passage there
    // reveals only the two useful actions requested by the user.
    frame.addEventListener("load", () => {
      const doc = frame.contentDocument;
      const win = frame.contentWindow;
      const rulesModal = doc?.querySelector(".modal");
      if (!doc || !win || !rulesModal || doc.querySelector("#rulesSelectionActions")) return;

      // Full-screen image viewer for the source images inside Rules.
      const rulesImageViewer = doc.createElement("div");
      rulesImageViewer.id = "rulesImageViewer";
      rulesImageViewer.innerHTML = `<div class="rules-image-viewer-bar" role="toolbar" aria-label="ابزار تصویر"><button type="button" data-image-action="zoom-out" aria-label="کوچک‌نمایی">−</button><button type="button" data-image-action="reset" aria-label="اندازه واقعی">100%</button><button type="button" data-image-action="zoom-in" aria-label="بزرگ‌نمایی">+</button><button type="button" data-image-action="save" aria-label="ذخیره تصویر" title="ذخیره تصویر"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3v11m0 0 4-4m-4 4-4-4M5 19h14"/></svg></button><button type="button" data-image-action="close" aria-label="بستن تصویر" title="بستن تصویر"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 6 12 12M18 6 6 18"/></svg></button></div><div class="rules-image-viewer-stage"><img alt="" draggable="false"></div>`;
      doc.body.appendChild(rulesImageViewer);
      const viewerImage = rulesImageViewer.querySelector("img");
      let viewerScale = 1;
      const setViewerScale = value => {
        viewerScale = Math.max(.5, Math.min(5, value));
        viewerImage.style.transform = `scale(${viewerScale})`;
        rulesImageViewer.querySelector('[data-image-action="reset"]').textContent = `${Math.round(viewerScale * 100)}%`;
      };
      const closeImageViewer = () => {
        rulesImageViewer.classList.remove("is-visible");
        viewerImage.removeAttribute("src");
        setViewerScale(1);
      };
      const openImageViewer = image => {
        viewerImage.src = image.currentSrc || image.src;
        viewerImage.alt = image.alt || "";
        rulesImageViewer.classList.add("is-visible");
        setViewerScale(1);
      };
      const viewerStyle = doc.createElement("style");
      viewerStyle.textContent = `#rulesImageViewer{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1200;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;background:rgba(7,10,20,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .18s ease,visibility .18s ease}#rulesImageViewer.is-visible{opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto}.rules-image-viewer-bar{display:flex;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 16px;direction:rtl}.rules-image-viewer-bar button{min-width:42px;height:38px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 80%,white 20%);border-radius:10px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--surface-solid) 88%,transparent);color:var(--text);font:800 13px/1 inherit;cursor:pointer}.rules-image-viewer-bar button svg{width:18px;height:18px;display:block;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.rules-image-viewer-bar button:hover,.rules-image-viewer-bar button:focus-visible{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-2)}.rules-image-viewer-bar button[data-image-action="close"]{margin-inline-start:auto}.rules-image-viewer-stage{min-height:0;flex:1;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:auto;padding:24px;touch-action:none}.rules-image-viewer-stage img{max-width:calc(100vw - 48px);max-height:calc(100vh - 112px);object-fit:contain;transform-origin:center;transition:transform .16s ease;cursor:zoom-in;user-select:none;-webkit-user-drag:none}.rules-image-viewer-stage img.is-zoomed{cursor:grab}@media(max-width:520px){.rules-image-viewer-bar{padding:10px}.rules-image-viewer-bar button{min-width:38px;height:36px;padding-inline:9px}.rules-image-viewer-stage{padding:12px}.rules-image-viewer-stage img{max-width:calc(100vw - 24px);max-height:calc(100vh - 84px)}}`;
      doc.head.appendChild(viewerStyle);
      const markRulesImage = image => {
        if (!image || image === viewerImage || image.dataset.rulesViewerBound === "1") return;
        image.dataset.rulesViewerBound = "1";
        image.style.cursor = "zoom-in";
      };
      rulesModal.querySelectorAll("img").forEach(markRulesImage);
      rulesModal.addEventListener("click", event => {
        const image = event.target.closest("img");
        if (!image || image === viewerImage) return;
        markRulesImage(image);
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        openImageViewer(image);
      });
      rulesImageViewer.addEventListener("click", event => {
        const action = event.target.closest("[data-image-action]")?.dataset.imageAction;
        if (action === "close") return closeImageViewer();
        if (action === "zoom-in") return setViewerScale(viewerScale + .25);
        if (action === "zoom-out") return setViewerScale(viewerScale - .25);
        if (action === "reset") return setViewerScale(1);
        if (action === "save" && viewerImage.src) {
          const link = doc.createElement("a");
          link.href = viewerImage.currentSrc || viewerImage.src;
          link.download = `ramp-rules-${Date.now()}.png`;
          link.click();
        }
      });
      rulesImageViewer.querySelector(".rules-image-viewer-stage").addEventListener("wheel", event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        setViewerScale(viewerScale + (event.deltaY < 0 ? .15 : -.15));
      }, { passive: false });
      doc.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
        if (event.key === "Escape" && rulesImageViewer.classList.contains("is-visible")) closeImageViewer();
      });

      const actions = doc.createElement("div");
      actions.id = "rulesSelectionActions";
      actions.setAttribute("role", "menu");
      actions.setAttribute("aria-label", "اقدام‌های متن انتخاب‌شده");
      actions.innerHTML = `
        <button type="button" role="menuitem" data-selection-action="search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10.8" cy="10.8" r="6.6"/><path d="m16 16 4
